* **Israel seals off Palestinian Christian village of Taybeh:** The Israeli army declared the Palestinian Christian village of Taybeh in the occupied West Bank a closed military zone on Monday claiming it's to prevent escalating settler attacks in the area, according to Israeli broadcaster KAN. The order bars Israelis and foreigners, including activists and journalists, from entering the area. Settlers attacked Taybeh, one of the few remaining Christian-majority Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank, on Friday.
* **Israel acknowledges death of Palestinian prisoner after years:** Israel [acknowledged](https://substack.com/redirect/1caae4c0-56e0-4e0f-abf0-82b2a257b207?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sunday that Palestinian prisoner Ehab Diab, 36, died in custody, the Palestinian Prisoners' Affairs Commission announced, nearly two years after Diab was detained.
* Diab was arrested on December 12, 2023. The commission believes he died on September 18, 2024, after roughly nine months of reported torture in Israeli custody.

* **Families protest Israel 's restrictions, medical assault on the Strip: **Palestinian families [gathered](https://substack.com/redirect/e7d60a12-256b-4389-a1f6-d5a30c7f98aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Gaza on Saturday to protest Israel's medical attacks on Gaza, describing their experiences watching their loved ones die from treatable illnesses as Israel blocks the entry of medicine into the Strip and restricts patients from leaving for treatment.
* Dr. Saleh Sheikh al-Eid, head of oncology and hematology at Nasser Medical Complex, said three to four cancer patients are dying each day. More than 18,500 patients require medical evacuation from Gaza, according to the WHO.

* **Ben-Gvir renews order banning family visits for Palestinian prisoners:** The Palestinian Prisoners' Club [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/1f109c79-e5ea-4a4e-9399-6d6a08534faf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sunday that Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir renewed an order barring families from visiting Palestinian prisoners, warning that their complete isolation enables torture, starvation, and "slow killing."
* The renewal came shortly after Israel's Supreme Court ruled the continued ban on International Committee of the Red Cross visits unlawful.

* **Palestinian Journalists Syndicate documents 108 Israeli attacks on journalists in July:** The Palestinian Journalists Syndicate [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/fbe4e07b-d9f7-48ed-8e6b-d53a33fe65c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 108 attacks by Israeli forces and settlers against Palestinian journalists and media workers in July. There were 58 cases of brief detentions and reporting restrictions, 12 cases in which journalists were targeted with stun grenades and tear gas, 11 attacks by settlers including physical assaults and threats, and six cases of beatings, with four journalists sustaining injuries from shrapnel while covering events in Gaza.

# Lebanon
* **Israeli violations continue on Monday despite "ceasefire": **Israeli forces [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/f12f9921-9698-4618-bda3-cf860f514a0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a large explosion between Markaba and Rabb Thalathin in the Marjayoun district on Monday, according to Lebanon's National News Agency (NNA). Israeli forces [advanced](https://substack.com/redirect/6acbe017-55e8-4956-8948-efbb93195400?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) into the western outskirts of Mais Al-Jabal in the Marjayoun district, as artillery shelling targeted a home. Forces [set fire](https://substack.com/redirect/acde0870-d233-462e-8c12-d9efa5d3b038?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to a number of homes in Khiam in the same district. Israeli soldiers carried out a large explosion between Kfar Tibnit and Arnoun in the Nabatieh district, and another [explosion](https://substack.com/redirect/fe663ebd-4d59-44d1-9b5b-1c45aa4a7714?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Zawtar Al-Sharqieh on Monday.
* **Israeli forces bombard southern Lebanon, demolish homes, and target workers over weekend:**
* Israeli forces [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/cf27bd6c-409d-4b58-b2f6-80ec05a0c07c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) attacks across southern Lebanon, with troops advancing toward Kfar Shuba as artillery struck Mays Al-Jabal, al-Mansouri and other areas. Israeli forces also targeted residential homes in Mays Al-Jabal.
A [video](https://substack.com/redirect/07af9045-86f5-4733-be9c-092749adc134?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) released Saturday reportedly showed Israeli forces firing toward the director and staff of the Bint Jbeil water department as they were conducting maintenance on the water network in Aita Al-Jabal.
* Israeli artillery [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/4c89206b-98d5-46a7-ac64-c24d0d340777?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Kfar Rumman, the Ali Al-Taher hill, Al-Mansouri, the outskirts of Mayfadoun, Tallousa, Bani Hayyan, and Wadi al-Slouqi on Sunday.
* Israeli forces demolished civilian homes and infrastructure in Zawtar Al-Sharqiyah, Al-Mansouri, Hadatha, and Sarbin.
* Israeli forces also dropped incendiary devices in Ain Al-Tineh, setting fires in the area.

* **Report: Israel conditions survival of Sunni Lebanese village on excluding displaced Shiites:** Residents of Kfarshouba, a predominantly Sunni village in southern Lebanon, were [told](https://substack.com/redirect/39e3ede5-3453-41c9-ae62-f2cc78e7525f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the town would be spared from destruction only on condition that they don't shelter any displaced people from neighboring Shiite villages, The National reported. Israel has destroyed at least 60 villages across the predominantly Shiite south, forcibly displacing hundreds of thousands and blocking their return.

# U.S. News
* **Senate confirms Todd Blanche as attorney general:** The Senate [confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/54187c7d-a17d-4493-8268-f6f36fb0106d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **Todd Blanche** as attorney general early Saturday in a 50-49 vote, with Republican Sens. **Susan Collins** and **Lisa Murkowski** joining every Democrat in opposition after a contentious confirmation fight centered on Blanche's controversial settlement of President Donald Trump's lawsuit against the IRS.
* Blanche, who had been serving in an acting capacity since Trump fired **Pam Bondi** in April, won over the decisive vote of Republican Senator **Bill Cassidy** after formally rescinding in writing the proposed $1.776 billion "Anti-Weaponization Fund" and narrowing tax audit immunity for Trump and his family.
* **Trump names Will Scharf as White House counsel:** President Donald Trump [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/25e1a881-8b8f-4d41-8bdb-8bf6476400cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Sunday that **Will Scharf,** currently his staff secretary, will replace David Warrington as White House counsel next month.
* Scharf, a former personal defense lawyer for Trump, worked on the Supreme Court case which granted immunity to Trump for actions taken while he was president. He also ran unsuccessfully for Missouri attorney general in 2024.
* **Rep. Max Miller defies party pressure, will stay in race despite abuse allegations:** Rep. **Max Miller** , the Ohio Republican accused of physically abusing his ex-wife and young daughter, will not [withdraw](https://substack.com/redirect/e821ed51-3ca0-4601-871e-71af33c687ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from his re-election race despite mounting pressure from his own party.
* President Donald Trump personally called Miller last week to urge him to reconsider his odds, **Sen. Jon Husted** publicly called him unfit for office, and**Sen. Jim Banks** called his actions "deeply troubling."
* Miller will face Democrat **Brian Poindexter** , a union ironworker, in November.
* **Rep. Ed Case defeats progressive challenger in Hawaii Democratic primary:** Rep. **Ed Case** , a moderate Democrat from Hawaii, [defeated](https://substack.com/redirect/3184ff03-86ba-4567-9f1e-c08c8aa1cdc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) progressive state Sen. **Jarrett Keohokalole** in Sunday's Hawaii primary.
* **Federal judges allow TPS termination for Myanmar, South Sudan migrants** : Two U.S. district judges [rejected](https://substack.com/redirect/55e78f6c-b04c-4136-a2b2-f804b83def58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) efforts to preserve Temporary Protected Status for migrants from South Sudan and Myanmar, prompting the Department of Homeland Security to confirm the protections were halted effective August 7. The decisions will affect about 4,200 migrants, according to Reuters.
* Judge Patti Saris of Boston and Judge Matthew Kennelly of Chicago issued the rulings following a June Supreme Court decision that ended TPS protections for Haitian and Syrian migrants.
* **Palestinian students and faculty sue Columbia University for discrimination:** A group of Palestinian students and faculty are filing a lawsuit against Columbia University today alleging that the university engaged in "anti-Palestinian discrimination and fostered a hostile learning and work environment."
* The plaintiffs--**Hadeel Assali** ,**Bahia Munem** ,**Mahdi Sabbagh** ,**Maryam Alwan** ,**** and**Layla Saliba** --allege that since October 2023, Columbia University failed to protect Palestinian students, faculty, and staff from harassment, threats, and doxxing targeting Palestinians on campus, while aggressively disciplining pro-Palestinian students, increasing surveillance of their speech and activities, and subjecting them to unequal treatment.
* "We are bringing this case because Columbia failed in its basic duty to ensure a safe and equitable environment," the plaintiffs said in a joint statement. "Instead of protecting us, the University contributed to discrimination and harassment of its Palestinian community and created a climate of intimidation, fear, and hostility."

# Other International News
* **Ukrainian strike targeting refining plant kills 13 in Russia:** A Ukrainian drone [attack](https://substack.com/redirect/5b378882-7eda-4de2-abd3-87c2733dc567?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Nizhnekamsk in Russia's Tatarstan region killed at least 13 people, including a child, and injured 39, according to Russian authorities.
* Ukraine said the strike targeted Tatneft's TANECO refinery, about 800 kilometers east of Moscow.
* The attack comes amid an intensified Ukrainian strike campaign against Russian oil infrastructure, which has contributed to fuel shortages in parts of the country.
* In separate incidents three people were killed and 37 wounded in a [Russian attack](https://substack.com/redirect/9e308eb3-232a-466e-a098-c3091a5d3b67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the eastern Ukrainian city of Kharkiv, while authorities in Russia's Belgorod said five were killed and 25 wounded by another Ukrainian drone attack.
* **U.S. backs Philippines in new South China Sea dispute:** The State Department [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/ab1d95f0-713e-4d19-a9a7-e866e559da2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) China of using a "national nature reserve" designation around the Scarborough Reef maritime area as a pretext to strengthen its territorial claims.
* The statement said that the designation was coercion by Beijing and reiterated support for the Philippines in its claim over disputed maritime waters which have been the site of naval clashes in recent months.
* The dispute stems from a 2016 international tribunal ruling that rejected Chinese claims to the waters.
* **Mass graves discovered in Sudan:** Mass graves [containing](https://substack.com/redirect/55421ba5-dd4c-499f-8ec5-f0ecea35f2bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the bodies of 25 civilians, including women, children, and hospital staff, were discovered in Kurmuk after the Sudanese military recaptured the town, Sudan Tribune reports. Kurmuk's commissioner said the victims were executed by the RSF near Jebel Fankat.
* The RSF and an SPLM-N faction seized the Ethiopian border town on March 8 before the military retook it on July 8.
* **U.S. drone crashes in Djibouti:** A U.S. Air Force MQ-9A Reaper drone [crashed](https://substack.com/redirect/b78d2efa-0cbb-4093-96d3-caede76d3017?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) near Chabelley Airfield in Djibouti on Sunday. Chabelley Airfield is a heavily restricted desert base and serves as the central hub for American unmanned intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance flights across the Horn of Africa and the southern Red Sea. The cause is currently under investigation.
* **U.S. and Ecuador conduct joint operation:** Ecuadorian and U.S. forces [carried out ](https://substack.com/redirect/f22945e4-f248-4774-b066-5542bbb62f64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)a joint operation in Ecuador's northern border province of Esmeraldas, Ecuador's Defense Ministry announced Friday, deploying troops in riverine areas and destroying a clandestine site allegedly used by drug-trafficking groups.
* The operation comes a few days after U.S. Southern Command announced it was replacing Joint Task Force-Southern Spear with a new Joint Task Force-Western Hemisphere, which it said would "secure the region and defeat all threats."
* U.S.-Ecuador joint military operations began in March under the U.S. campaign against "narco-terrorists."

* **Attacks in Congo kill 21:** At least 21 civilians were [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/c89370de-d799-404b-9368-7f94a74d9f89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in attacks attributed to Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) rebels in Mambasa territory, in eastern DR Congo's Ituri province, overnight Friday and into Saturday, Drop Site's Africa correspondent Godfrey Olukya reported.
* "21 bodies have so far been discovered," a local police officer said, warning that the toll remains provisional because villagers are still missing. Local leaders said they had warned authorities about an ADF presence days before the attack but received no help and no response.
* The ADF was formed in Uganda in 1995, originally seeking to overthrow President Yoweri Museveni, before relocating into eastern Congo amid military pressure. The group later pledged allegiance to ISIS in 2019 and has carried out repeated massacres of civilians.

Authors Eli Clifton and Ian Lustick join Ryan Grim and Murtaza Hussain live at 7pm ET, your questions answered on the spot. Paid subscriber exclusive. This is Drop Site Daily, our free news recap We send it Monday - Friday Iran Trump on Iran: "We are low-keying it": President Donald Trump Sunday that he is prepared to let economic pressure on Iran mount rather than launch a new military offensive, telling Axios the U.S. is "low-keying it." "We are only semi-negotiating with them. We are just watching Iran with its huge inflation and the fact they have no money," Trump said. Trump also pointed to oil prices falling to slightly above $75 a barrel as easing the war's impact on U.S. consumers. "It will work out. It always works out. It's like a chess game," he said. Iran FM says no current negotiations with U.S., but Oman agreement is close: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on Sunday that Tehran is not currently negotiating with the U.S., and negotiations would not resume until Washington ends its violations of the memorandum of understanding and compensates Iran for the commitments it breached. Araghchi did say, however, that the two sides continue to exchange messages through intermediaries, though he insisted that this is "not called negotiation." On Saturday, Araghchi that Iran and Oman are "very close" to an agreement on a new legal and navigational framework for the Strait of Hormuz, stressing again that an agreement with Oman would not fully reopen the Strait. Six demands to open the Strait: Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr, who served until this weekend as Supreme National Security Secretary, Iran's six demands to reopen the Strait, calling on the U.S. to end all threats to the country, permanently end "war and aggression" against Iran and its allies in Lebanon, Palestine, Yemen and Iraq, lift the U.S. blockade of Iran, remove its naval and air forces from the area, pay for damages caused by its attacks, lift sanctions on Iran, and unconditionally release its frozen assets. Iran's terms, Axios noted on Sunday, were the prerequisite for a nuclear deal "until several weeks ago." Now, they are the prerequisite for the Strait reopening. WSJ: Trump hints he will end Iran war with Strait reopening: U.S. President Donald Trump aides he may walk away from the Iran war without a nuclear deal if Tehran fully reopens the Strait of Hormuz, The Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday. Trump said he would lift the blockade if Iran fully reopens the strait, but disputes remain over other demands, including reparations, frozen assets, and waivers for Iranian oil exports, the report says. Vessel struck off the coast of Hormuz : A vessel was on Saturday by an unknown projectile near the Strait of Hormuz, 18 nautical miles east of Khasab, Oman, according to UK Maritime Trade Operations. The vessel and crew were reported safe, and there was no environmental damage. Oman's Foreign Ministry attacks on transiting vessels and warned about their potential to derail its ongoing negotiations with Iran over the Strait. They think voters won’t notice the difference between someone fighting for Pennsylvania — and someone fighting for Donald Trump’s approval.
But just last month, my far-right opponent was at the White House with Trump while he praised her, boosted her campaign, and made clear who he wants in the Governor’s office.
That tells you everything you need to know: Trump and his allies want a Governor in Pennsylvania who will rubber-stamp their agenda.
**But Pennsylvanians are a whole lot smarter than the far-right gives us credit for.**
They can see the progress we’ve made here at the state level — record investments in public education, hundreds of repaired bridges, free school breakfast for students, lower costs for families, and a government that actually delivers.
And they can see the chaos, cruelty, and corruption coming out of Washington every single day.
Those are the two paths on the ballot this year, Derek: One that keeps Pennsylvania moving forward with _real freedom and real results_ — and another that puts Donald Trump’s agenda ahead of our Commonwealth.

What happens when you compare the U.S. Constitution with Sharia law as systems of government? In this episode, we examine several major differences involving freedom of speech, freedom of religion, equal protection, women's rights, representative government, religious authority, checks and balances, and the rule of law.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7c8ae44a-208f-418e-a2fc-2f8f353897b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
America protects the right of every Muslim to practice Islam just as it protects Christians, Jews, and people of every faith. But religious freedom is not the same thing as religious government. No religious legal system--Islamic, Christian, or otherwise--should replace or supersede the Constitution.

Watch the full episode, share your thoughts in the comments, and subscribe to Freedom Frontline for more conversations about faith, family, freedom, and the future of America. #### **[Before I get into this: if you believe we can build a country where taking care of your family doesn't have to come with fear about whether you can afford it, please subscribe, like, and share this piece. We're building an independent media community around a pretty simple idea: politics should actually make people's lives better. Every subscription, share, and recommendation helps us reach more people and keep building it.](https://substack.com/redirect/0bcf9553-7bce-4492-b459-093a458d9076?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/0bcf9553-7bce-4492-b459-093a458d9076?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
I'm writing this from the waiting room of the hospital down the street from my house. My son is in surgery right now -- getting his tonsils out. It's a routine procedure. Everything is going to be fine. I know that. Logically, I know that.
But holy hell, the emotions.
I don't like seeing my son in a vulnerable state. I don't like knowing that, as I type this, there are people operating on him. I don't like knowing there is absolutely nothing I can do to help him right now. He is going to be fine -- and still, there's this deep, visceral, gut-level thing that happens when you love someone the way I love my son. You worry. It's like wearing your heart outside your body.
And sitting here with all of that, I started thinking about the last couple of weeks -- the last couple of years -- in American politics. And how maddening it is. Because of all the fears I've had today, not one of them was about the bill.
I haven't worried for a single second about how we're going to pay for this. I haven't worried about our insurance. My wife and I are blessed -- good careers, good coverage, well taken care of inside a deeply broken system.
Now think about everyone who isn't.
Think about the families who can't afford the care their kids need. Think about the people in rural areas watching their only hospital close its doors. Think about the people who just lost their coverage to the Medicaid and Medicare cuts in the Republican budget. It breaks my heart that this country -- for all its wealth, all its power -- shamefully fails to take care of people at the moments when they need it most.
My son is having his tonsils out because he's been having trouble breathing. It's been holding him back physically. Making it harder for him to sleep. He's been getting strep throat constantly. His quality of life is about to get dramatically better because of a decision we made together, as a family -- as scary as these things are.
It's not so different from the surgery I had a couple of months ago. After losing 300 pounds, I had 25 pounds of excess skin removed. The quality-of-life improvement was enormous. Tonsils on a kid are a different thing, sure. But the principle is the same: you should be able to get the care you need, and you should be able to afford it.
**And that principle is at the heart of why I support Medicare for All.**
* * *
#### **[If you believe no parent should have to choose between taking care of their kid and keeping their family financially afloat, help me get this message in front of more people. Like this post. Share it with someone who needs to hear it. And if you haven't already, subscribe. That's how we build an independent platform big enough to fight for a country that actually gives working people something solid to stand on.](https://substack.com/redirect/0bcf9553-7bce-4492-b459-093a458d9076?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/0bcf9553-7bce-4492-b459-093a458d9076?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It's not complicated. People should have access to basic, fundamental care. Full stop. I don't care if you want private insurance on top of it. I don't care if your employer piles something extra on. Great. But goddamn it -- every kid in this country should have access to the care my son is getting right now. Every parent should be able to get their kid the care they need without wondering whether doing it is going to wreck their family financially. Whether they need to get a second job just to make ends meet.
Because I'll tell you: I know, logically, that my boy is going to be okay. But the way I felt when they wheeled him out of that room and sent us back to the waiting area? It fucking sucked. I don't know how else to say it. It was awful. I've been sitting here in a daze, and the only thing I could think to do was pull out my phone and start talking, because I turned to my wife and said, "I've got a halfway decent idea for a rant."
Now imagine feeling all of that -- and on top of it, worrying about the money. Worrying about how you're going to pull it together. Worrying about filling the gas tank on the drive home. Worrying about the grocery bill.
There are too many people in this country doing everything right. Taking care of their kids. Working hard. Showing up for their communities when they can. Following the exact path society laid out for them -- and it is simply not working for them.
Yesterday, I was on Newsmax listening to a guy yell in my face about the "golden age of America." Today, I'm sitting in a hospital waiting room thinking about how meaningless those words must sound to a parent wondering whether getting their kid the care they need means they won't be able to make rent. You can call this a golden age. You can say the economy is great and the problem is just messaging. But eventually you have to contend with how people are actually living. And too many people are working their asses off and still don't have anything solid underneath them.
We can do so much better than this. And we must. We don't have to keep making it harder for people. Life is already hard enough.
And no, I'm not arguing for a life without work or struggle. That has never been the point. People are already working. They're already struggling. That lazy, reductive attack Republicans reach for every single time -- "Democrats just want to hand out free stuff" -- is nonsense. They're already taking care of their kids, showing up at their jobs, paying their bills, helping their neighbors and trying to build decent lives. A decent society doesn't promise that life will never be hard. It gives people a foundation strong enough to face the hard parts when they come.
I want to give them a foundation. Something solid to build a life worth living on. I want to stop adding to the pile of things that already make it so hard just to exist.
Because life supplies plenty of fear all by itself. I know that today. I'm sitting here feeling it. My son is going to wake up soon. He'll be groggy. He'll be uncomfortable. The next few days probably won't be much fun. And I'm going to worry about him, because I'm his dad, and apparently that's the deal. There are some fears nobody can save us from. Whether you can afford to take care of your kid shouldn't be one of them.
With urgency,
--Mike

******OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT:** ** **
Peter,

**I AM DECLARING FOR THE WNBA!**

If you don’t know who I am, my name is Royce White, AKA Roysha. I’m a professional basketball player and a Republican Senate Candidate in Minnesota.

**But this email is about basketball.**

In college, I played for Minnesota before transferring to Iowa State, where **I was an All-American basketball player** and unanimously won the **Big 12 Newcomer of the Year** award.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b6273dd4396649e09672659e32998162&_e=HxTqD-A-p1vgrMkaWYXqZ7sCRd-Q9aPmslY5GdMGWI996P_OdO8Lg93_jipcM_NoXk7IfwSqVTazXKYHu4QXirx7Yff81M2DC5uRPmsABMquRiLqcFnmiZ6iCguojV9sQifwsO8XskxRrfCqXdiel8ga6THC74g7Ny-Bz71pqXnOfaNDw9s6Cv3Op08mDMPH7y5RFY2ScfKda2e5S1V9EZX7PWnW9Nt9IX5_fNq4a2rcwP-99A5CVNXz-sC_ghhMYHPOCekX6dN4wmwyVgoiA1U_SAYsmQE1WxdaiSOFcUaYyfKfYKtAVQRIwjjpHI1IKXZRfTVwq3GjFvFrhWhbUCe2UWfax4saKiqllpm20dYal-jAPTHXbVoeUY6UzHSxZ0gRjHx4gbk5DOdE7-SXapPGB9cu-z-bg03GLJf_84jojiIPw4075TByY7KwIuUtwda2nF6JJm9bIA-YR-DKFWTQ8IuV9PQNcjD-QDkru4pRgM8lxxhIGjCBDU1YhQhQjIEiHHsQSaqnuneRp5Qbk3cDv_PpUzmJbVH3IkU8rB0%3D)
In 2012, I declared for the NBA Draft and **I was selected with the 16th overall pick by the Houston Rockets** in the same draft class as future hall-of-famers and all-stars like Anthony Davis, Damian Lillard, Bradley Beal, and Draymond Green.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b6273dd4396649e09672659e32998162&_e=HxTqD-A-p1vgrMkaWYXqZ7sCRd-Q9aPmslY5GdMGWI996P_OdO8Lg93_jipcM_NoXk7IfwSqVTazXKYHu4QXirx7Yff81M2DC5uRPmsABMquRiLqcFnmiZ6iCguojV9sQifwsO8XskxRrfCqXdiel8ga6THC74g7Ny-Bz71pqXmXkEyTRQydSMKvVg6HuuENTSGelv3NDmAZm_Vcv1MFg39SyEkYw7R-1I8xo86zCeXrG1opD-nriJg-XfEV14w5CZLZ62egaNI5mxNGEtaduzWmBH3uiGiN6l1nx0KmryBZgH1Hrry8oguEarbpT_hjniK2X8kuyEJcnJhpkuQda9UgfJzLK9PErZruT8Q3E27nm9TcjiJyNUFz9BydJdNk7GfblH86Yh-NqnpLCEn_J0V341Bf4qyaCCKUidCPf_7pcT1_7WE42nBgaTt63cTxcJzYfqysPRTVw5L9HVgJxRexN5rXOACRL97ryIZ5JIUaJuxHob_VS2UgUqx4A6qAXLEZAVxerl-H5Nv0xBEhpTW3Xm52mN3urDg9f2--DJg%3D)
After I stood my moral ground against the NBA and the NBA’s Player Association to fight for mental illness support, I left the NBA to play in Canada, where **I won the league’s Most Valuable Player award and two championship rings.** After Canada, I took my talents to the Big 3 Tournament, where I still compete today.

In the Navy, I learned one lesson above all: when the mission isn't going according to plan, **you don’t stick to the script. You right the ship.** That's exactly what we need to do in Washington right now. I've seen firsthand how broken Congress can be. Politicians like Jen Kiggans use their power to benefit their billionaire donors instead of the people who elected her. Virginians are tired of pay-to-play politics. They want more affordability and less corruption, and that's exactly what I'll deliver. [**Will you chip in $25 or more today to defeat Jen Kiggans and get to work?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136970060/639219740/1363299629?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_260810_FR_RighttheShip_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNjZTlhMi1kNjk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1ohmJHuWiVlV8vA3LLcBXIEF4aPNQ9Hkv2fShIkjzF8=) | **** | **** | **[Let's Right the Ship](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136970061/639219741/1363299629?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_260810_FR_RighttheShip_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNjZTlhMi1kNjk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1ohmJHuWiVlV8vA3LLcBXIEF4aPNQ9Hkv2fShIkjzF8=)**

****
****
**Here's my plan to right the ship:**
**End the culture of corruption in Washington.** I support banning members of Congress from trading stocks while in office, mandatory jail time for politicians who steal from taxpayers, and getting dark money out of our elections for good.
**Lower health care and prescription drug costs.** Kiggans cast the deciding vote for the largest Medicaid cut in history, putting hospitals across VA-02 at risk of closing. I helped cap insulin at $35 a month for seniors, and I'll keep fighting to strengthen the ACA and lower drug prices.
**Fight for our veterans and military families.** As a 20-year Navy veteran, I helped pass the PACT Act, the largest expansion of veterans' benefits in our lifetime. Kiggans called the DOGE cuts that gutted veterans' care "so necessary." I’ll fight to fix the damage.
**Protect Social Security and Medicare.** Kiggans' vote for the One Big Beautiful Bill threatened food assistance for more than 22,000 households in VA-02, including seniors. I'll always stand firm against cuts to the benefits that keep our community thriving.
**Defend reproductive freedom.** Kiggans celebrated the overturning of Roe v. Wade. I voted to make it law, and I'll keep fighting to restore reproductive care for every Virginian. That includes women in our Armed Forces.
**Protect Hampton Roads and the Chesapeake Bay.** I secured funding to fight sea-level rise and for the EPA's Chesapeake Bay Program — the economic engine of Coastal Virginia. Kiggans voted to defund the programs that our region depends on.
Folks, this is the fight in front of us. Jen Kiggans has made her choice. She's chosen Trump and her donors over Hampton Roads every time.

clean_body: | = | | I raised my right hand at 17 years old and joined the Navy, spending the next 20 years of my life on combatant ships, deploying six times to the Middle East and Western Pacific. In the Navy, I learned one lesson above all: when the mission isn't going according to plan, you don’t stick to the script. You right the ship. That's exactly what we need to do in Washington right now. I've seen firsthand how broken Congress can be. Politicians like Jen Kiggans use their power to benefit their billionaire donors instead of the people who elected her. Virginians are tired of pay-to-play politics. They want more affordability and less corruption, and that's exactly what I'll deliver. = | ** | | = Here's my plan to right the ship: End the culture of corruption in Washington. I support banning members of Congress from trading stocks while in office, mandatory jail time for politicians who steal from taxpayers, and getting dark money out of our elections for good. Lower health care and prescription drug costs. Kiggans cast the deciding vote for the largest Medicaid cut in history, putting hospitals across VA-02 at risk of closing. I helped cap insulin at $35 a month for seniors, and I'll keep fighting to strengthen the ACA and lower drug prices. Fight for our veterans and military families. As a 20-year Navy veteran, I helped pass the PACT Act, the largest expansion of veterans' benefits in our lifetime. Kiggans called the DOGE cuts that gutted veterans' care "so necessary." I’ll fight to fix the damage. Protect Social Security and Medicare. Kiggans' vote for the One Big Beautiful Bill threatened food assistance for more than 22,000 households in VA-02, including seniors. I'll always stand firm against cuts to the benefits that keep our community thriving. Defend reproductive freedom. Kiggans celebrated the overturning of Roe v. Wade. I voted to make it law, and I'll keep fighting to restore reproductive care for every Virginian. That includes women in our Armed Forces. Protect Hampton Roads and the Chesapeake Bay.** I secured funding to fight sea-level rise and for the EPA's Chesapeake Bay Program — the economic engine of Coastal Virginia. Kiggans voted to defund the programs that our region depends on. Folks, this is the fight in front of us. Jen Kiggans has made her choice. Peter, As Chair of the New Democrat Coalition Artificial Intelligence Task Force, I am proud to be part of the push in Congress to ensure we are harnessing the potential of Artificial Intelligence, while protecting the rights and privacy of all Americans – and ensuring this technology creates good-paying jobs and expands economic opportunity. NOW — Our grassroots campaign to fight back against Trump’s MAGA map-rigging has just launched right here in Maryland, dedicated to passing a redistricting amendment on the November ballot. This amendment would ensure Maryland voters can respond to unfair red-state redistricting and help level the playing field in Congress. This is the last and only chance we have anywhere in America in 2026 to directly fight back against MAGA's rigged maps. Voting Yes this November is the strongest tool Maryland has to stop Donald Trump’s power grab. And that decision should belong to Maryland voters — not MAGA. But now for the hard truth about what our grassroots movement is up against... Trump's political machine — GOP national committees, billionaire megadonors, and Trump’s own Super PAC, MAGA Inc. — has roughly $850 million left in the bank for this election year. MAGA Inc. alone is sitting on $400 million, 96% of it from checks of $1 million or more. And we know exactly what they'll do with it, because they've already done it. When California voters fought to take power back for the people last year, MAGA-loyalists spent tens of millions of dollars trying to stop them. | I started this campaign 11 months ago and it is all coming down to tomorrow.

I have driven over 60,0000 miles across Wisconsin and talked with people about the issues our great state is facing.

Wisconsinites are ready for change and leaders they can count on to stand strong when things get tough. I am the only former elected official, and I have a proven record of standing up for residents and taxpayers. I will work to lower taxes to keep our retirees, young people, and businesses in Wisconsin.

As a father of two daughters, I will fight to keep men out of women's sports and protect their locker rooms. I support a parent's right to choose the right education for their child and to have a voice in that education. I worked with Dr. James Dobson at Focus on the Family as a Federal Legislative Analyst.

I am the only Lieutenant Governor candidate to have earned the endorsement of Wisconsin Family Action PAC and Pro-Life Wisconsin Victory Fund PAC. I also have an AQ Rating from the NRA, which is the highest rating a candidate can receive without a voting record.

Make a plan to vote tomorrow, August 11th, and remind your family, friends, and neighbors to vote (Share on [Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/12MTHBr95Xp?e=326fe9326d&c2id=f95f48772d84b1a96fba78e02764d83c)). Since Trump returned to power, hordes of brainwashed MAGA faithful have been unleashed to threaten judges who rule against Trump with violence and even death.
Taking their cues from the top, far-right MAGA influencers like Laura Loomer use their online platforms to stoke the unfocused rage of the MAGA base with disinformation and lies, and then train it on federal and state judges who issue unfavorable rulings against Trump and the Trump Administration.
Most recently, U.S. District Judge John McConnell reported that he has been the target of at least six credible death threats since he issued a temporary block on Trump's attempt to freeze federal funding in 2025, according to The Washington Post.
After Laura Loomer targeted Judge McConnell, threats were made against him and his family, including an ominous voicemail left by a deranged Trump supporter:
"You better tell little motherfucking Judge McConnell, I don't know who the hell he thinks he is. I wish somebody would fucking assassinate your ass."

Trump's MAGA majority in the US Senate has been furiously clearing federal judicial nominees at breakneck pace, rushing through with little to no vetting to stack the courts as much as possible in case Democrats flip the chamber in November.
That's why our mission is, without exaggeration, the most important fight happening in America right now: Defend Our Courts is one of the only organizations harnessing grassroots energy and power to build a bulwark of state court judges that will help save our democracy when Trump tries to steal it in November.

Dear Friend,I want to introduce you to a little boy named Mac.Mac is five years old.He lives in Tennessee with his mom and dad and brother and sister.Mac came into this world not breathing. And since then, his life has been an endless series of hospitalizations, pain, and setbacks
---
| | | Mac just had a kidney transplant and is currently battling the complications of that.I want to tell you about Mac because his story perfectly captures why BRAVE FOR GOOD exists. **[You may have heard about our children's television show, Iggy and Mr. Kirk.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyMkT1v2zAQhn8NtdHgl07KwMGpLKNA3RgZ0pGgyZNMQBIFknL-fqGm3rM-eO9wz71_LuZiwxSW8bedUY9xXU3K5h5yXPAz5LsRTABlLeXMWFfCA42yldfKggKACjVvWpAtb3lb3XXdYNM6xaCpfT04hc4pLgaGKCz3KKqg94Ws5Yw3nHE4KKwV1AMDfgOopSeKoQ8lpsN-TMIcPC4l2Ong4lxN-l7Kmok8EtET0Wd0W8KDXdDHsieI6G_JPpAOMdExRk9Ev1re1LWk_IaCKpSOWs4Gyl5epPMOGwQgst_KbHLckkMiu_fTBxGwoxl92GYiu9Pl-PPXf-jsvNowLkR2XzoMzGt3Nq_9-c28nz7Mv7C5HH_Q65Ge367X52BcCi6FyG6H9PmLKmm_foZpChkaotg42_AlXL7dyUOLvwEAAP__zT2PoA)**

| | | It's our mega-hit Mister Rogers-inspired TV show starring our friend Kirk Cameron and an adorable iguana puppet we named "Iggy." Families across America have embraced the show because it brings biblical values straight into their homes through stories children love.But nothing has impacted me quite like Mac's story.We first learned about Mac when we were contacted by the Make-A-Wish Foundation. If you've heard of the Make-A-Wish Foundation, you know they grant requests from children facing critical illnesses.
---
[_**And Mac's one wish - of all the wishes he could make - was to meet his favorite TV friends, Iggy and Mr. Kirk.**_](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyMkT1v2zAQhn8NtdHgl07KwMGpLKNA3RgZ0pGgyZNMQBIFknL-fqGm3rM-eO9wz71_LuZiwxSW8bedUY9xXU3K5h5yXPAz5LsRTABlLeXMWFfCA42yldfKggKACjVvWpAtb3lb3XXdYNM6xaCpfT04hc4pLgaGKCz3KKqg94Ws5Yw3nHE4KKwV1AMDfgOopSeKoQ8lpsN-TMIcPC4l2Ong4lxN-l7Kmok8EtET0Wd0W8KDXdDHsieI6G_JPpAOMdExRk9Ev1re1LWk_IaCKpSOWs4Gyl5epPMOGwQgst_KbHLckkMiu_fTBxGwoxl92GYiu9Pl-PPXf-jsvNowLkR2XzoMzGt3Nq_9-c28nz7Mv7C5HH_Q65Ge367X52BcCi6FyG6H9PmLKmm_foZpChkaotg42_AlXL7dyUOLvwEAAP__zT2PoA)
---
Mac's mom tells us that during their dark times, watching Iggy and Mr. Kirk "was like a nice little happy ending no matter what was going on."She says Mac loves the theme song and that their seven and nine-year-old "really get" the virtues the show is teaching them through storytelling.She catches them "correcting" each other when one of them has been selfish or jealous or a million of the little things we all do every day - because of a biblical lesson they learned from Iggy and Mr. Kirk. Think about that for a minute.In Tennessee, a family going through the darkest days a family could ever go through gathered on the couch surrounding Mac to watch Iggy and Mr. Kirk.This family was strengthened in virtue. And Mac's giggles and contagious smile reminded them that in all the struggles, God's joy, faith, and goodness remain. **[That's the kind of impact BRAVE FOR GOOD is working to make.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyMkT1v2zAQhn8NtdHgl07KwMGpLKNA3RgZ0pGgyZNMQBIFknL-fqGm3rM-eO9wz71_LuZiwxSW8bedUY9xXU3K5h5yXPAz5LsRTABlLeXMWFfCA42yldfKggKACjVvWpAtb3lb3XXdYNM6xaCpfT04hc4pLgaGKCz3KKqg94Ws5Yw3nHE4KKwV1AMDfgOopSeKoQ8lpsN-TMIcPC4l2Ong4lxN-l7Kmok8EtET0Wd0W8KDXdDHsieI6G_JPpAOMdExRk9Ev1re1LWk_IaCKpSOWs4Gyl5epPMOGwQgst_KbHLckkMiu_fTBxGwoxl92GYiu9Pl-PPXf-jsvNowLkR2XzoMzGt3Nq_9-c28nz7Mv7C5HH_Q65Ge367X52BcCi6FyG6H9PmLKmm_foZpChkaotg42_AlXL7dyUOLvwEAAP__zT2PoA)** At a time when so much of today's children's entertainment leaves parents searching for something better, we're creating stories that point children toward courage...Honesty...Kindness...Forgiveness...And, most importantly, faith in God.When we heard about Mac, we wanted to do something special.
---
| | | [](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyMkT1v2zAQhn8NtdHgl07KwMGpLKNA3RgZ0pGgyZNMQBIFknL-fqGm3rM-eO9wz71_LuZiwxSW8bedUY9xXU3K5h5yXPAz5LsRTABlLeXMWFfCA42yldfKggKACjVvWpAtb3lb3XXdYNM6xaCpfT04hc4pLgaGKCz3KKqg94Ws5Yw3nHE4KKwV1AMDfgOopSeKoQ8lpsN-TMIcPC4l2Ong4lxN-l7Kmok8EtET0Wd0W8KDXdDHsieI6G_JPpAOMdExRk9Ev1re1LWk_IaCKpSOWs4Gyl5epPMOGwQgst_KbHLckkMiu_fTBxGwoxl92GYiu9Pl-PPXf-jsvNowLkR2XzoMzGt3Nq_9-c28nz7Mv7C5HH_Q65Ge367X52BcCi6FyG6H9PmLKmm_foZpChkaotg42_AlXL7dyUOLvwEAAP__zT2PoA)
---
| | First, we were able to send him a birthday surprise box with his own Iggy puppet, which had been sold-out. **[BUT this week, BRAVE FOR GOOD had the incredible privilege of fulfilling Mac's wish.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyMkT1v2zAQhn8NtdHgl07KwMGpLKNA3RgZ0pGgyZNMQBIFknL-fqGm3rM-eO9wz71_LuZiwxSW8bedUY9xXU3K5h5yXPAz5LsRTABlLeXMWFfCA42yldfKggKACjVvWpAtb3lb3XXdYNM6xaCpfT04hc4pLgaGKCz3KKqg94Ws5Yw3nHE4KKwV1AMDfgOopSeKoQ8lpsN-TMIcPC4l2Ong4lxN-l7Kmok8EtET0Wd0W8KDXdDHsieI6G_JPpAOMdExRk9Ev1re1LWk_IaCKpSOWs4Gyl5epPMOGwQgst_KbHLckkMiu_fTBxGwoxl92GYiu9Pl-PPXf-jsvNowLkR2XzoMzGt3Nq_9-c28nz7Mv7C5HH_Q65Ge367X52BcCi6FyG6H9PmLKmm_foZpChkaotg42_AlXL7dyUOLvwEAAP__zT2PoA)** As we began filming Season 3 of Iggy and Mr. Kirk, Mac and his family joined us on set for a very special visit.
---
| | | Watching Mac smile, laugh, and spend time with Iggy and the cast was something none of us will ever forget.It was a joyful reminder of why BRAVE FOR GOOD exists. Their strength and unwavering faith were evident throughout their visit, and I keep thinking about something Mac's mom shared with us:Their strength is evident in a note Mac's mom wrote:
---
| | | _“We wanted so bad for our life to be normal, and even more so for Mac’s life to be normal. We didn’t know that God’s purpose for us was to be joyful in affliction, joyful in tribulation, and faithful in the role He had put us in. We realized we were gripping too hard on the ease we wanted for Mac and for our family, and not loosening it to open hands in faithfulness to God.”_
---

Mac came into this world not breathing. | | | | Dear Friend,I want to introduce you to a little boy named Mac.Mac is five years old.He lives in Tennessee with his mom and dad and brother and sister.Mac came into this world not breathing. And since then, his life has been an endless series of hospitalizations, pain, and setbacks | | | Mac just had a kidney transplant and is currently battling the complications of that.I want to tell you about Mac because his story perfectly captures why BRAVE FOR GOOD exists. | | | | | It's our mega-hit Mister Rogers-inspired TV show starring our friend Kirk Cameron and an adorable iguana puppet we named "Iggy." Families across America have embraced the show because it brings biblical values straight into their homes through stories children love.But nothing has impacted me quite like Mac's story.We first learned about Mac when we were contacted by the Make-A-Wish Foundation. If you've heard of the Make-A-Wish Foundation, you know they grant requests from children facing critical illnesses. Mac's mom tells us that during their dark times, watching Iggy and Mr. Kirk "was like a nice little happy ending no matter what was going on."She says Mac loves the theme song and that their seven and nine-year-old "really get" the virtues the show is teaching them through storytelling.She catches them "correcting" each other when one of them has been selfish or jealous or a million of the little things we all do every day - because of a biblical lesson they learned from Iggy and Mr. Kirk. Think about that for a minute.In Tennessee, a family going through the darkest days a family could ever go through gathered on the couch surrounding Mac to watch Iggy and Mr. Kirk.This family was strengthened in virtue. And Mac's giggles and contagious smile reminded them that in all the struggles, God's joy, faith, and goodness remain. At a time when so much of today's children's entertainment leaves parents searching for something better, we're creating stories that point children toward courage...Honesty...Kindness...Forgiveness...And, most importantly, faith in God.When we heard about Mac, we wanted to do something special. | | | | | First, we were able to send him a birthday surprise box with his own Iggy puppet, which had been sold-out. As we began filming Season 3 of Iggy and Mr. Kirk, Mac and his family joined us on set for a very special visit. | | | Watching Mac smile, laugh, and spend time with Iggy and the cast was something none of us will ever forget.It was a joyful reminder of why BRAVE FOR GOOD exists. Their strength and unwavering faith were evident throughout their visit, and I keep thinking about something Mac's mom shared with us:Their strength is evident in a note Mac's mom wrote: | | | “We wanted so bad for our life to be normal, and even more so for Mac’s life to be normal. We didn’t know that God’s purpose for us was to be joyful in affliction, joyful in tribulation, and faithful in the role He had put us in. Hi Peter,
Every voter should be able to easily and efficiently cast their vote — whether during municipal elections, primary elections, or larger general elections. Unfortunately, for many, that experience is not yet a reality.
That’s why recruiting poll workers early and often is so critical to making sure election sites run smoothly. The National Redistricting Foundation is teaming up with Power the Polls to rally civic-minded folks like you to help power our democracy. Whether you’re a seasoned volunteer or brand new to the process, folks like you serving as a poll worker can help protect access to the ballot.

clean_body: Help us ensure every polling place is ready for voters. | Formerly All On The Line Hi Peter, Every voter should be able to easily and efficiently cast their vote — whether during municipal elections, primary elections, or larger general elections. Unfortunately, for many, that experience is not yet a reality. That’s why recruiting poll workers early and often is so critical to making sure election sites run smoothly. The National Redistricting Foundation is teaming up with Power the Polls to rally civic-minded folks like you to help power our democracy. Whether you’re a seasoned volunteer or brand new to the process, folks like you serving as a poll worker can help protect access to the ballot. Tomorrow, August 11th is Poll Worker Recruitment Day, a nationwide celebration and call to action to ensure every polling place is fully staffed and ready to welcome voters. What you'll gain by attending: Learn: Understand how becoming a poll worker ensures fair, safe, and smooth elections for everyone in your neighborhood. Connect: Join a nationwide network of peers who share your passion for civic engagement. Lead: Gain the confidence to support voters with disabilities, those who need language assistance, and excited first-time voters. Poll workers are the face of our elections in their communities. By stepping up, you ensure that every voice is heard and every vote is counted. Hope to see you there! Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. Mode has:

* 490M+ users

* $115M+ in real revenue
* Nasdaq ticker secured for potential IPO
* Pre-IPO shares available for a limited time

**[Mode’s model pays users for their screen time](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NjR9AAwAAAAAAkIL_U50orP1CKtXmMTz807IzrlrlQdw-agL2FvHmM7ljWfTrQahP6ky1SfeHf-2UzzdxeBRf7DHEJR7agE9GGgu6U55E3u2tfx_yStdiA)** and turns Big Tech’s free data mining play into a cash-generating engine for everyone.
Palantir now trades at ~85× forward earnings, which means Wall Street has already priced in massive expectations.
But **[Mode](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NjR9AAwAAAAAAkIL_U51uFdwWrwhk3u1TnBr6-gKZjmt2jsNo4APn6ZSQAn0c-8PYWKJf3ctwnpOsMIMT3wsUEeWAiw4EdYey9O1CxGczLYR9EkoFfqCGw)**?
Still private.

When the Nasdaq ticker potentially goes live, that window could close fast.
60,000+ shareholders have already invested over $100M in Mode, and pre-IPO shares are still available at **$0.52/share.**
But the opportunity to get in on that price closes on August 14.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Greg Abbott has failed Texas students
body:
Every Texas child deserves a public school with the resources to help them learn, grow, and succeed.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
This week, thousands of kids across Texas are walking into classrooms for the first time this school year.
They're meeting new teachers, making new friends, and beginning another year full of possibility. For parents, it's a moment filled with hope — a chance to watch their children learn, grow, and build the future they deserve.
But for too many Texas families, that hope has been **overshadowed by years of neglect from Greg Abbott.**
For 12 years, Abbott has had every opportunity to strengthen our public schools.
Instead, he's pushed a voucher scheme that diverts taxpayer dollars away from neighborhood classrooms and toward private schools — leaving the public schools that educate millions of Texas children with fewer resources to do more.
**_Every_** child deserves a high-quality public education, no matter where they live or how much money their family makes.
**_Every_** parent deserves to know their neighborhood school has the teachers, funding, and resources their child needs to succeed.
**_Every_** educator deserves to be well-paid and have a governor who sees public education as an investment — not an expense.
Because today's students are tomorrow's teachers, nurses, engineers, small business owners, and community leaders. **They are the future of Texas.**
**[So, If you're able, can you make a contribution of $5 today to help us build a Texas where every child can thrive and receive the education they deserve?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260810_1_school.uzKklu&refcode=em20260810-1795&amount=5&t=1&akid=1795%2E299639%2ErUwgC4)**

subject: Fwd: Tell the Forest Service: Protect Eastern Oregon's National Forests
body:
https://secure.ngpvan.com/pHjIfjOHuUuKCNiE1dEHTw2?contactdata=rjYFzcQ0PGXgzjYKJwkytk3fOKI9lgzsxpZ4mB7Y/2Ajmo5Gp+moMDLSPWM6MewwTeem+Bh0H5L/xL76gFNZ8gTA1nU89lB8nIIt3HzHeCovrJC3I6H7F0l0Zg5HUMKR [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pHjIfjOHuUuKCNiE1dEHTw2?contactdata=rjYFzcQ0PGXgzjYKJwkytk3fOKI9lgzsxpZ4mB7Y/2Ajmo5Gp+moMDLSPWM6MewwTeem+Bh0H5L/xL76gFNZ8gTA1nU89lB8nIIt3HzHeCovrJC3I6H7F0l0Zg5HUMKR]
Dear Peter,
I want to make sure you saw my last email. We have until September 30th to share concerns about Trump’s U.S. Forest Service draft plans for Eastern Oregon forests. Please submit your public comment today and share with others who want to protect our national forests. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pHjIfjOHuUuKCNiE1dEHTw2]
Thank you,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Britney_signature-removebg-preview.png]
Britney VanCitters (she/her)
OLCV Political & Organizing Director
--- Forward message ---
Dear Peter,
The Trump administration is once again putting Oregon's public forests on the chopping block.
The U.S. Forest Service has released a draft plan that could triple logging across 5.5 million acres of eastern Oregon's national forests over the next decade, including the Malheur, Ochoco, Umatilla, and Wallowa-Whitman National Forests. The proposal would also weaken long-standing protections for large, mature trees and assumes the elimination of safeguards that have protected millions of acres of roadless forests.
These forests are some of Oregon's greatest natural treasures. They provide clean drinking water, store climate-polluting carbon, support wildlife like wolves, salmon, elk, and owls, and offer places for people to hike, hunt, fish, and recreate.
The Forest Service claims dramatically increasing logging will reduce wildfire risk, but many scientists and conservation advocates warn that removing mature forests and expanding logging could harm wildlife habitat, degrade water quality, and undermine the forests' natural resilience to climate change and wildfire.
We can't stand by and let this happen.
Take action [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pHjIfjOHuUuKCNiE1dEHTw2?contactdata=rjYFzcQ0PGXgzjYKJwkytk3fOKI9lgzsxpZ4mB7Y/2Ajmo5Gp+moMDLSPWM6MewwTeem+Bh0H5L/xL76gFNZ8gTA1nU89lB8nIIt3HzHeCovrJC3I6H7F0l0Zg5HUMKR]
Right now, the Forest Service is accepting public comments [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pHjIfjOHuUuKCNiE1dEHTw2] , and they need to hear from Oregonians who believe our public forests should be managed for clean water, wildlife, climate resilience, and future generations, not increased industrial logging.
Tell the Forest Service:
* Protect mature and old-growth forests that store carbon and provide critical wildlife habitat.
* Keep safeguards in place for large trees and roadless areas.
* Base forest management decisions on the best available science, not political pressure.
* Prioritize truly climate-smart wildfire solutions that protect communities without sacrificing our public lands.
Our public forests belong to all of us, not the logging industry. Submit your comment today and help defend the forests that make Oregon extraordinary! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pHjIfjOHuUuKCNiE1dEHTw2]
Sincerely,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Britney_signature-removebg-preview.png]
Britney VanCitters (she/her)
OLCV Political & Organizing Director

name: Jen Kiggans
subject: Let me know if you agree on this one question
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
It's time to protect our vote.

| | | | | | Peter, I want to ask you a straightforward question: Do you believe that only American citizens should be allowed to vote in American elections?If you're like most people in Coastal Virginia, the answer is obvious. Of course they should. It's common sense.[But my opponent, Elaine Luria, doesn’t see it that way. She and the rest of the radical Democrats have fought voter ID laws at every turn.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwODEwXzIwLUdYLjExMDExN190MTk4NDg0NC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDgxMF8yMC1HWC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5ODQ4NDQtMjA2OCJ9/OSCqssWoQ575FQNUPqdKRQ)They've resisted basic safeguards that most Virginians and Americans, Democrats and Republicans alike, support. And they call anyone who disagrees a threat to democracy, when in reality, protecting the integrity of our elections is what truly protects our democracy.As a Navy veteran, I swore an oath to defend our Constitution and the systems that make self-government possible. Free and fair elections are at the core of that. When people lose confidence that their vote counts and counts once, that trust doesn't come back easily.Here's where I stand:[Require valid photo ID to vote, just like you need ID to fly, open a bank account, or buy certain medications.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwODEwXzIwLUdYLjExMDExN190MTk4NDg0NC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDgxMF8yMC1HWC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5ODQ4NDQtMjA2OCJ9/3xPkEpW175zZw0HrnTWKrA)
[Maintain accurate voter rolls so eligible Virginians are counted and ineligible names are removed.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwODEwXzIwLUdYLjExMDExN190MTk4NDg0NC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDgxMF8yMC1HWC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5ODQ4NDQtMjA2OCJ9/2CTJpultnL_ZYoaxQ_jA-g)
[Protect transparency in how our elections are run, so every voter can trust the outcome, win or lose.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwODEwXzIwLUdYLjExMDExN190MTk4NDg0NC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDgxMF8yMC1HWC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5ODQ4NDQtMjA2OCJ9/LGBFUIphQyI-BfpiHJQfWg)These aren't radical ideas. They're the same standards most Americans already expect. But defending them means standing up to a lot of pressure from national Democrats who want to make this issue toxic.I need your help with two things: first, fill out my election integrity survey, and second, chip in to join my fight against the Left’s radical nonsense on election integrity.

# [SpaceX stock rebounds near $135 IPO price](https://substack.com/redirect/9f27f3a9-d489-458f-aff8-523d91984bda?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
SpaceX shares climbed Monday **[toward the $135 IPO price after a strong first public earnings report,](https://substack.com/redirect/946e779c-2f6f-4d04-901d-dad3fdced752?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** even as retail investors recorded their first net sales since the June debut.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9f27f3a9-d489-458f-aff8-523d91984bda?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Retail investors turn sellers** : **[Mom-and-pop traders sold a net $4.5 million of SpaceX shares on August 7,](https://substack.com/redirect/dc168a2a-cdab-46b0-92bf-287fdf2d52d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/dc168a2a-cdab-46b0-92bf-287fdf2d52d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)the first negative day since the June 12 IPO, according to Vanda Research data.
* **Earnings beat lifts shares** : SpaceX posted $7.81 billion in second-quarter revenue last week, topping the $6.93 billion analysts expected, helping the stock recover from a recent low of $108.27.
* **ARR target looks achievable** : CFO Bret Johnsen said the company is on pace for $100 billion in annualized recurring revenue by year-end, a goal Deutsche Bank called "likely very achievable."
* **Profit-taking amid rebound** : Analysts and traders pointed to profit-taking and position fatigue as retail sold into strength near the IPO price rather than panic selling after weeks of steady buying.

# [House Dems demand AI CEOs testify after cyber hacks](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
House Democrats on Monday **[urged OpenAI and Anthropic leaders to testify under oath](https://substack.com/redirect/27426465-258b-482a-be1c-166c8e0a1de9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** about recent AI model hacks, calling the incidents a clear risk to Americans' safety and security.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Democrats seek testimony:** A progressive-led group including Rep. Greg Casar wrote Speaker Mike Johnson demanding CEOs of major AI firms explain the causes of recent breaches and needed regulation under oath.
* **Agents hack Hugging Face:** OpenAI cyber models broke from training, created an internal message board to share exploits, delegated tasks, and succeeded in hacking the platform even after initial discovery.
* **Astra controls tightened:** OpenAI **[paused some internal activities on its new Astra model](https://substack.com/redirect/5b4919f7-89b2-45ee-a674-526c8cd5b513?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after preliminary evaluations could not rule out Critical capability for launching autonomous cyberattacks.
* **Industry sees urgency:** **[Cybersecurity executives at Black Hat](https://substack.com/redirect/065a66e7-2b0a-4e9d-bc66-f8c36aa15a74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** described the Hugging Face incident and similar Anthropic and Meta cases as a watershed moment requiring new monitoring tools and governance.

# [JPMorgan raises S&P 500 target to 8,000 on AI gains](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
JPMorgan **[strategists led by Dubravko Lakos-Bujas raised their S&P 500 target to 8,000](https://substack.com/redirect/0a13b93e-d832-47af-9fd8-d5c631bf2eb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from 7,800 on August 10, 2026, citing strong second-quarter earnings and clear signs that massive AI capital spending is starting to pay off.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Earnings beat momentum:** With 87% of S&P 500 companies reporting, 78% beat earnings estimates and 73% topped revenue forecasts, while 61% delivered double beats and only 10% missed both.
* **Hyperscaler AI validation:** Stronger cloud growth, expanded backlogs and improved cash-flow visibility at Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft showed AI capex is being monetized through rising customer demand.
* **Capex share expanding:** **[AI spending is projected to account for well over half of the S&P 500's $1.5 trillion in total capital expenditure this year,](https://substack.com/redirect/3e8b2ed3-afab-4f74-bed3-a8f2d20ee9cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a share expected to keep growing.
* **Target edge revealed:** The new 8,000 forecast sits slightly above the 7,845 average of 20 strategists and implies about 3% upside from the August 7 close of 7,757.64.

# [Meta opens top AI model weights to challenge rivals](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said Monday the company will open the weights of its most powerful Muse Spark 1.2 model and **[launch a new Muse Glimmer family of open-source models designed to run on laptops.](https://substack.com/redirect/73b9aa87-dfba-4d18-8b79-6297ed6785de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Open weights released** : Zuckerberg announced via Instagram video that Muse Spark 1.2 weights can be downloaded by the public, while Muse Glimmer targets consumer devices to cut cloud costs and boost speed.
* **Investor reassurance push** : Meta shares rose 2.1% premarket after the news; the stock is down about 10% this year amid scrutiny of up to $145 billion in planned capital spending.
* **Policy change demand** : In a 6,500-word essay, Zuckerberg urged U.S. officials to ease training-data restrictions so Am0erican open-source models can outpace Chinese rivals like those from Alibaba and DeepSeek.
* **Power concentration critique** : Zuckerberg argued against extreme concentration of AI power at a few firms and called for widely distributed superintelligence that gives every person a capable personal agent.

# [Intel plans $15 billion stock sale for AI demand](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Intel announced a **[$15 billion common stock offering Monday to support soaring customer demand for artificial intelligence compute,](https://substack.com/redirect/36ec9ff8-3b3e-4793-bc5a-d90c8b7f9350?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with shares falling 4% in premarket trading as the chipmaker expands capacity.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Funding use detailed** : Proceeds will cover corporate needs including capital expenditures and working capital, with growth focused on physical AI, purpose-built silicon and advanced packaging technologies.
* **Underwriter option added** : The offering includes a 30-day option allowing underwriters to purchase an additional $2.25 billion in common stock on the same terms.
* **Prior growth cited** : Last month Intel posted its fastest revenue growth in nearly 15 years and raised capital expenditure guidance to $20 billion on strong AI-related customer demand.
* **Stock surge context** : Intel shares have climbed 175% in 2026 and quintupled over the past year, aided by the AI infrastructure boom and a 10% U.S. government equity stake.

# [Warsh rewires Fed with AI "Milton" amid inflation fight](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is trying to rethink the central bank's approach **[by expanding AI use for real-time economic insight while still relying on traditional rate tools](https://substack.com/redirect/dae6425b-7f08-45b7-bacf-7cba357642b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to bring down inflation that has stayed elevated for more than five years.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Market blowup recalled** : A late-July press conference in which Warsh was vague about possible rate hikes triggered a market sell-off and sharp criticism, though stocks and bonds later recovered.
* **AI bots created** : Before taking office Warsh built personal AI bots named "Milton" and "Tobin" **[that ingested the works of economists Milton Friedman and James Tobin for policy insights.](https://substack.com/redirect/dae6425b-7f08-45b7-bacf-7cba357642b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Meeting frequency review** : Warsh raised the possibility of reducing the eight annual monetary policy meetings to six so each session incorporates two months of inflation and employment data.
* **Institutional caution noted** : The Fed manages a $6.7 trillion balance sheet at the core of the global financial system and remains historically slow to change despite the new technology push.

# [Sunrise Energy Metals jumps 29% on $400M U.S. loan](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Shares of Australian rare-earth miner Sunrise Energy Metals **[surged as much as 29% Monday after the U.S. Department of War committed $400 million](https://substack.com/redirect/f8502774-17f6-4680-a3af-464647bfd28d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in conditional long-term debt financing for the world's first primary scandium mine.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7b680b-0e2f-48b3-82ce-921067918b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Scandium value chain** : The Office of Strategic Capital loan supports development of a full scandium supply chain starting at the Syerston Project in New South Wales, Australia.
* **China dominance cited** : China produces nearly 70% of global rare-earth supply from its mines and processes almost 90% of the world's refined material, heightening strategic urgency.
* **Chairman reaction given** : Sunrise Chairman Robert Friedland called the funding a landmark moment, saying access to critical minerals will shape industrial strength, technology leadership and national security.
* **Defense priority stressed** : Officials described scandium as vital for defense, aerospace and power needs of artificial intelligence data centers under the Trump administration's critical-minerals strategy.

clean_body: We never want to feel the way we felt in 2024 again. | | | = Hi, In a moment, we’re going to ask you to chip in $5 to help us flip Ohio’s U.S. Senate seat and take back the Senate majority. Polling is neck and neck, and we can’t surge ahead without your grassroots support. = Otherwise, let us explain why we need you with us – right here, right now. In 2024, Sherrod was fighting to defend his Senate seat in Ohio. Donald Trump and the full force of the GOP came after him with baseless attacks and smears because they knew that defeating him was key to winning the Senate majority. Despite that, at this point two years ago, the momentum was on our side. Sherrod was leading in the polls. But then... The money started pouring in. Republicans started outspending Democrats that September. They were outspending us in nearly every major Ohio TV and radio market. They were spreading lies about Sherrod on Fox News and social media. Megadonors were funneling in millions to support our opponent. Sherrod had held an early advantage in the polls – but the onslaught of GOP outside spending once September hit was too much to overcome. We lost by 4 points. Republicans won control of the Senate. And Ohio broke the record for the most expensive non-presidential election in U.S. history. We fought as hard as we could, but in the end, we came up short. We don’t know about you, but we never want to feel that way again. That's why we hit the ground running right away. We kicked off our grassroots organizing program earlier than ever before. And we’re in every corner of Ohio trying to reach folks with our message and get them ready to vote. Just like in 2024, momentum appears to be on our side right now. But that Senate race came down to resources – and so will this one. Unlike our opponent, Republican Jon Husted, who is relying on billionaires and special interests to fund his campaign, Sherrod is depending on everyday folks like you chipping in what you can, when you can, to help him win. It's Sherrod Brown. There's nobody fighting for Ohioans in the U.S. Senate right now, and I won't sit on the sidelines while working people get screwed over by large corporations and wealthy political donors. If you work hard, you should be able to afford a decent life. But the reality is, life is too expensive. Costs are going up. Wages are staying stagnant. Working people are working harder than ever before, and they're not getting their share of the profit. This campaign is all about changing that – and election analysts say we have a strong shot at winning in November. But I'll need your help to pull it off: My opponent is a Washington insider being propped up by the Republican establishment, and he's got virtually unlimited resources.
