Mac came into this world not breathing. | | | | Dear Friend,I want to introduce you to a little boy named Mac.Mac is five years old.He lives in Tennessee with his mom and dad and brother and sister.Mac came into this world not breathing. And since then, his life has been an endless series of hospitalizations, pain, and setbacks | | | Mac just had a kidney transplant and is currently battling the complications of that.I want to tell you about Mac because his story perfectly captures why BRAVE FOR GOOD exists. | | | | | It's our mega-hit Mister Rogers-inspired TV show starring our friend Kirk Cameron and an adorable iguana puppet we named "Iggy." Families across America have embraced the show because it brings biblical values straight into their homes through stories children love.But nothing has impacted me quite like Mac's story.We first learned about Mac when we were contacted by the Make-A-Wish Foundation. If you've heard of the Make-A-Wish Foundation, you know they grant requests from children facing critical illnesses. Mac's mom tells us that during their dark times, watching Iggy and Mr. Kirk "was like a nice little happy ending no matter what was going on."She says Mac loves the theme song and that their seven and nine-year-old "really get" the virtues the show is teaching them through storytelling.She catches them "correcting" each other when one of them has been selfish or jealous or a million of the little things we all do every day - because of a biblical lesson they learned from Iggy and Mr. Kirk. Think about that for a minute.In Tennessee, a family going through the darkest days a family could ever go through gathered on the couch surrounding Mac to watch Iggy and Mr. Kirk.This family was strengthened in virtue. And Mac's giggles and contagious smile reminded them that in all the struggles, God's joy, faith, and goodness remain. At a time when so much of today's children's entertainment leaves parents searching for something better, we're creating stories that point children toward courage...Honesty...Kindness...Forgiveness...And, most importantly, faith in God.When we heard about Mac, we wanted to do something special. | | | | | First, we were able to send him a birthday surprise box with his own Iggy puppet, which had been sold-out. As we began filming Season 3 of Iggy and Mr. Kirk, Mac and his family joined us on set for a very special visit. | | | Watching Mac smile, laugh, and spend time with Iggy and the cast was something none of us will ever forget.It was a joyful reminder of why BRAVE FOR GOOD exists. Their strength and unwavering faith were evident throughout their visit, and I keep thinking about something Mac's mom shared with us:Their strength is evident in a note Mac's mom wrote: | | | “We wanted so bad for our life to be normal, and even more so for Mac’s life to be normal. We didn’t know that God’s purpose for us was to be joyful in affliction, joyful in tribulation, and faithful in the role He had put us in. We realized we were gripping too hard on the ease we wanted for Mac and for our family, and not loosening it to open hands in faithfulness to God.” “We wanted so bad for our life to be normal, and even more so for Mac’s life to be normal. We didn’t know that God’s purpose for us was to be joyful in affliction, joyful in tribulation, and faithful in the role He had put us in. We realized we were gripping too hard on the ease we wanted for Mac and for our family, and not loosening it to open hands in faithfulness to God.” | | | | | If those words resonate with you, I'm asking you to become part of BRAVE FOR GOOD's mission.God did not create us for "easy."We were created for so much more. “ For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.” [2 Corinthians 4:17-18] With SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY, our Bible Revival movement, and Season 3 of Iggy and Mr. Kirk all moving forward at the same time, we need faithful friends to help us continue reaching children and families with wholesome, Godly values.Your tax-deductible gift today will help us reach many more children like Mac and encourage families searching for entertainment they can truly trust.We would be truly grateful for your support.Thank you for taking the time to read Mac's story. I hope you'll join us.Sincerely, | | | Dr. Trent Talbot Founder, BRAVE For Good | | | | P.S. body:
Abbott's Lead is Disappearing

| |
---|---|---
|
# Your support has gotten us this close
### Abbott's Lead is Disappearing
| | Aug 10
---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9d8169fe-4656-4de3-8297-e82ab6d7365e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Thanks to all of your support, my race for Governor against Greg Abbott is _**statistically tied**_. That's a big deal. We have momentum heading into these last two months before early voting starts.
To put this in perspective, earlier in the year we were five points behind, then three points, and now we are just one point away from getting Abbott out of the Governor's mansion for good!
This is not a fluke. This is proof that our on the ground strategy of driving all across Texas is working and our message is resonating. We want every Texan to have a seat at the table and feel heard. The days of paying the Greg Abbott Corruption Tax are over. No more profits over educating our kids. No more data centers guzzling our water supply. And no more governors who prioritize their billionaire donors' needs over Texans.
**This is the second poll within a week that shows that we 're ONE-POINT away from defeating Greg Abbott. We **_**can**_**make history this election cycle, but only if we give this campaign everything we got.**
I'm not sending this message to everyone. I'm reaching out to you personally because I know you've supported me in the past. We are at the point in the election cycle where every decision we make counts. We've started to make tough decisions about when to spend big early and risk going off the airwaves or wait to communicate and risk waiting too long. That means whatever money we have in the bank will go directly to supporting voter outreach and getting our message across. Unfortunately, that level of investment requires a huge amount of resources.
**[You 've already done so much for me, but today I have one special request. If it makes sense for you right now, can you please chip in $10, $5, or $1? Every dollar you give is an investment in the future of Texas.](https://substack.com/redirect/9d8169fe-4656-4de3-8297-e82ab6d7365e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE ->](https://substack.com/redirect/9d8169fe-4656-4de3-8297-e82ab6d7365e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If you believe what I believe -- that Texans deserve change and new leadership. I'm hoping that I can count on your support.
Thank you for standing by me,
Gina
* * *

I have an important message for you: Thank you.

This campaign isn’t just about me — it’s about showing the strength of the incredible movement we’ve created for a better, stronger Pennsylvania.

Thank you for trusting me to fight for you in D.C., for standing by me through every tough race, and for showing up when it matters most.

From serving on the Scranton School Board to working in the PA Auditor General’s office to serving as Mayor of Scranton (Paige Against the Machine forever!) — my mission has always been to take on corruption and put our families, neighbors, and communities first.

My public service has been dedicated to rooting out waste, fraud, and abuse in government.

Now, I’m ready to take that fight to a place that needs it badly: a Congress controlled by special interests and self-serving politicians who put the people last.

Whether you’ve supported us financially or are supporting our campaign in other ways, you’ve proven that people power beats big money and Washington special interests every time. If you can, consider chipping in now to bring us one step closer to winning this race.

That is why they are flooding this race with outside money, building turnout operations, and laying the groundwork to flip this seat before most people are even paying attention. They are moving aggressively because they believe Republicans are not ready for this fight. We cannot afford to prove them right. If we lose even one seat, everything changes. One seat is the difference between confirming President Trump’s nominees or watching Democrats obstruct every appointment. One seat is the difference between advancing a conservative agenda or handing Chuck Schumer the power to shut it down. One seat is the difference between securing the border, restoring American energy dominance, and defending our values, or watching the radical Left regain control. That one seat could come down to Montana. And here is the part that should concern every conservative reading this: Democrats are already gaining ground while too many Republicans are still sitting on the sidelines. The time to act is not next month. It is not next week. It is today. That’s how you can help, Fellow Patriot. Kurt Alme is the kind of conservative leader we need in the United States Senate. He is a Montana native with a record of service, toughness, and results. He understands what is at stake and is prepared to fight for Montana and the future of this country. But Senate races are not won on good intentions alone. They are won by building the resources necessary to fight back before the other side defines the race. Right now, Democrats are trying to bury Montana under a tidal wave of money and misinformation. If we wait too long to respond, we may not get another chance to stop them. That is why I am urgently asking you to step up immediately. Do not assume someone else will do it. Do not assume we can catch up later. The window to act is closing fast, and the consequences of losing this seat would be enormous. The Senate majority is on the line. President Trump’s agenda is on the line. The future direction of this country is on the line. We have to fight like it. Hey y’all,
I’m still smiling. And I have a feeling I will be for a while.
What happened on August 6th was the result of a year of living rooms, front porches, turkey calls at dawn, and conversations with people across all 17 counties of this newly drawn congressional district who are ready for something different. You made that possible, and I do not take that lightly for a second.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/aVn56fr9TS031rYgTGZe7g~~/AAUS1hA~/OczKcZNVTtgyoialO2iwpr-09k443UcT1sa8SmLJBkRVdmMPN0aBw_Mz4f57gaYjSzR1cyDXs2DP7bi9SeXhrPmD5fD2dvGXEOt5V2dD16qUIGP_25BYarjrueapLmME9dhk1s9H3dyYxU1BrIP1ayZ2u4gjjKziyG1izECoAtInVN-URRvMhp1UWgBYS9VReFA1OX4v0ruCyuJy97rvhbW7BUiGqXRkIpedD8esbUIRtd1M0TxPuyFx5pUZX9jd2HSzmXsaWCfMAKc_eQmY5Q~~)
But I woke up this morning thinking about November. We have less than 90 days. Less than 90 days to reach voters who did not participate in the primary, to deepen the relationships we have built, and to make the case to every corner of our congressional district that this is their moment too.
This is now an open seat. Andy Ogles is out, and voters across TN-05 are hungry for change. Charlie Hatcher will try to hold this seat for the establishment, but he’s never faced a race like this one. The people of this district have already shown they’re ready for something different. Now we have to make sure they have someone worth voting for in November.
My mom taught me to follow through on my promises. I made a promise to this district, and I intend to keep it. But I need you with me to do it.

subject: Will you join our focus group? >> -

body:
| | | Hi friend, it's Senator Kirsten Gillibrand. I am honored to serve as your Chair of the DSCC.

My entire career, I've believed in **the power of grassroots activism.** I know that campaigns ‐‐ and Senate majorities ‐‐ are won by the people who put in the work, from volunteers knocking on doors and stuffing envelopes to supporters sharing their priorities. _And that last piece is why I want to hear from you._

**[Today, I'd like to invite you to join my DSCC Focus Group. Flipping the Senate depends on knowing what issues and messages matter most to this team, so it's important that we hear from top supporters like you. Your feedback will enable us to build our strategy to take back the majority ‐‐ so please, will you take my survey before midnight?](https://go.dscc.org/go/23373?ask=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-ND-20260810-Kirsten-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20260810-Kirsten-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&akid=25326%2E9716520%2E_YpSB6)**

| | [ENTER FOCUS GROUP](https://go.dscc.org/go/23373?ask=7&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-ND-20260810-Kirsten-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20260810-Kirsten-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&akid=25326%2E9716520%2E_YpSB6)

Donald Trump has spent years attacking your personal freedoms, and now that he's back in office, that will only continue.

The Senate is our _best chance_ at stopping the MAGA agenda and putting forth a positive Democratic vision. Together, we can flip the Senate and pursue that bold path, but we'll only be effective if we incorporate _your_ invaluable knowledge of the landscape we face.

**[So please, will you take a few moments to join my DSCC Focus Group by completing a brief survey before midnight? Democrats are at our strongest when we hear from supporters like you, so I'm humbly asking you to take a few moments to share your thoughts on how we can win.](https://go.dscc.org/go/23373?ask=7&t=7&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-ND-20260810-Kirsten-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20260810-Kirsten-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&akid=25326%2E9716520%2E_YpSB6)**

The path forward starts today. It's a privilege to be your DSCC Chair, and **[with your input](https://go.dscc.org/go/23373?ask=7&t=8&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-ND-20260810-Kirsten-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20260810-Kirsten-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&akid=25326%2E9716520%2E_YpSB6)** , we'll build our strongest majority yet.

With gratitude,

Kirsten

subject: Will you personally endorse my campaign?

body:
My re-election campaign is in full swing and I would be so grateful to have you on my team.

Join the DNC, New Disabled South Rising, and the College Democrats of America Disability Caucus **TODAY** for a training call on voting rights for people with disabilities and poll workers. As the Trump administration relies on public unawareness to threaten our fundamental voting rights, we must unite to learn about our rights to accessibility accommodations, poll worker assistance, mail-in voting, and private, independent voting.
**JOIN US TO:**
* Learn about your voting rights and how you can support people with disabilities at the polls;
* Hear from community members who have had their rights threatened;
* Find out how to get more engaged in voter protection.

**EVENT DETAILS : **
* **Date** : **TODAY,** August 10, 2026
* **Time** : 6:30 PM ET
* **RSVP** : [https://win.dnc.org/disabilityKYR](https://us.list-manage.com/v4eQy3qXkMa?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)

This event will feature live CART captioning**** and American Sign Language (ASL) Interpretation.
Your participation is critical to the DNC’s mission to fight back against injustice and protect voting rights throughout America.

| | | Peter,

7 years ago, Trump made the phone call that forever altered the lives of my twin brother and me.
On that day, my brother, Alexander Vindman, listened as President Trump attempted to extort our ally, Ukraine, by withholding military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated Joe Biden.
At the time, I was serving as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House. After Alex reported the call to me, my brother and I made the fateful decision to do our patriotic duty and stand up to Donald Trump at the risk of our decades-long military careers.
We blew the whistle on him and reported his corrupt phone call with Ukraine up the chain of command. Our actions eventually led to his impeachment, and Trump retaliated by firing us from our posts.
The decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump cost me and my brother our military careers. But over two decades ago, I swore an oath to protect our country and our Constitution from threats, foreign and domestic, and I would not let Trump deter me from that duty.
I ran for Congress to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.
In and out of Congress, I’ve done everything in my power to hold Trump and his MAGA cronies accountable — no matter the political cost — because I’ll never stop defending truth, democracy, and working Americans. But speaking out comes with consequences.
I’m already one of Trump’s and the GOP’s top targets in the House. National Republicans have already dumped millions into ads smearing and attacking me. Republicans have made it clear that they’ll spare no resources in kicking me out of Congress. And Trump even launched a sham investigation into me to kick me out of Congress.
Peter, it’s only going to get worse from here. We’re 85 days out from Election Day, and they’ll stop at nothing to stop me from serving you and holding them accountable.
So 7 years after the phone call that changed my and my brother’s lives, I am asking you to support my campaign so I can continue defending our democracy and fighting for you in Congress.

Dear Friend,I want to introduce you to a little boy named Mac.Mac is five years old.He lives in Tennessee with his mom and dad and brother and sister.Mac came into this world not breathing. And since then, his life has been an endless series of hospitalizations, pain, and setbacks
---
| | | Mac just had a kidney transplant and is currently battling the complications of that.I want to tell you about Mac because his story perfectly captures why BRAVE FOR GOOD exists. **[You may have heard about our children's television show, Iggy and Mr. Kirk.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkc2OmzAUhZ_G7Iz8A9hZeJEpYRSpaauJNF1axr7AlQAjbDKvX6Xt7Gf76d4jfef8vtmbwxnX8YdbwGBKdk92whRX-MA0WcFEQ5mmnFnnMz7AVq4IphZcD7oAw5VupFa15MVkqqp3uq9FzSHASTBW-aH3AZQSoXdaFmieeUxzxnVVS1b6k5KNrgfPQxhg6EnFji24DCWuCQMkH-O2xRkz-lTGfSxmM-W8JSLPRHREdAn8sUPpVggxlz4uRHT97h5Ah7jTMcZARLc5rupaUt6DoBVITx1nA2Wnk_TBg4KmIbI78mJTPHYPRLZvl3cimidaIOCxENlebufr9__Qu2VzOK5Etv-UWGNf2lf70r3-tG-Xd_v32N7O3-ivM73e759_cc2wZiLb6_1OP9sodhO2D5xnTI0iFRsXh_NTpshf3eRhxJ8AAAD__00zkPg)**
---
| | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkc2OmzAUhZ_G7Iz8A9hZeJEpYRSpaauJNF1axr7AlQAjbDKvX6Xt7Gf76d4jfef8vtmbwxnX8YdbwGBKdk92whRX-MA0WcFEQ5mmnFnnMz7AVq4IphZcD7oAw5VupFa15MVkqqp3uq9FzSHASTBW-aH3AZQSoXdaFmieeUxzxnVVS1b6k5KNrgfPQxhg6EnFji24DCWuCQMkH-O2xRkz-lTGfSxmM-W8JSLPRHREdAn8sUPpVggxlz4uRHT97h5Ah7jTMcZARLc5rupaUt6DoBVITx1nA2Wnk_TBg4KmIbI78mJTPHYPRLZvl3cimidaIOCxENlebufr9__Qu2VzOK5Etv-UWGNf2lf70r3-tG-Xd_v32N7O3-ivM73e759_cc2wZiLb6_1OP9sodhO2D5xnTI0iFRsXh_NTpshf3eRhxJ8AAAD__00zkPg)
---
| | | It's our mega-hit Mister Rogers-inspired TV show starring our friend Kirk Cameron and an adorable iguana puppet we named "Iggy." Families across America have embraced the show because it brings biblical values straight into their homes through stories children love.But nothing has impacted me quite like Mac's story.We first learned about Mac when we were contacted by the Make-A-Wish Foundation. If you've heard of the Make-A-Wish Foundation, you know they grant requests from children facing critical illnesses.
---
[_**And Mac's one wish - of all the wishes he could make - was to meet his favorite TV friends, Iggy and Mr. Kirk.**_](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkc2OmzAUhZ_G7Iz8A9hZeJEpYRSpaauJNF1axr7AlQAjbDKvX6Xt7Gf76d4jfef8vtmbwxnX8YdbwGBKdk92whRX-MA0WcFEQ5mmnFnnMz7AVq4IphZcD7oAw5VupFa15MVkqqp3uq9FzSHASTBW-aH3AZQSoXdaFmieeUxzxnVVS1b6k5KNrgfPQxhg6EnFji24DCWuCQMkH-O2xRkz-lTGfSxmM-W8JSLPRHREdAn8sUPpVggxlz4uRHT97h5Ah7jTMcZARLc5rupaUt6DoBVITx1nA2Wnk_TBg4KmIbI78mJTPHYPRLZvl3cimidaIOCxENlebufr9__Qu2VzOK5Etv-UWGNf2lf70r3-tG-Xd_v32N7O3-ivM73e759_cc2wZiLb6_1OP9sodhO2D5xnTI0iFRsXh_NTpshf3eRhxJ8AAAD__00zkPg)
---
Mac's mom tells us that during their dark times, watching Iggy and Mr. Kirk "was like a nice little happy ending no matter what was going on."She says Mac loves the theme song and that their seven and nine-year-old "really get" the virtues the show is teaching them through storytelling.She catches them "correcting" each other when one of them has been selfish or jealous or a million of the little things we all do every day - because of a biblical lesson they learned from Iggy and Mr. Kirk. Think about that for a minute.In Tennessee, a family going through the darkest days a family could ever go through gathered on the couch surrounding Mac to watch Iggy and Mr. Kirk.This family was strengthened in virtue. And Mac's giggles and contagious smile reminded them that in all the struggles, God's joy, faith, and goodness remain. **[That's the kind of impact BRAVE FOR GOOD is working to make.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkc2OmzAUhZ_G7Iz8A9hZeJEpYRSpaauJNF1axr7AlQAjbDKvX6Xt7Gf76d4jfef8vtmbwxnX8YdbwGBKdk92whRX-MA0WcFEQ5mmnFnnMz7AVq4IphZcD7oAw5VupFa15MVkqqp3uq9FzSHASTBW-aH3AZQSoXdaFmieeUxzxnVVS1b6k5KNrgfPQxhg6EnFji24DCWuCQMkH-O2xRkz-lTGfSxmM-W8JSLPRHREdAn8sUPpVggxlz4uRHT97h5Ah7jTMcZARLc5rupaUt6DoBVITx1nA2Wnk_TBg4KmIbI78mJTPHYPRLZvl3cimidaIOCxENlebufr9__Qu2VzOK5Etv-UWGNf2lf70r3-tG-Xd_v32N7O3-ivM73e759_cc2wZiLb6_1OP9sodhO2D5xnTI0iFRsXh_NTpshf3eRhxJ8AAAD__00zkPg)** At a time when so much of today's children's entertainment leaves parents searching for something better, we're creating stories that point children toward courage...Honesty...Kindness...Forgiveness...And, most importantly, faith in God.When we heard about Mac, we wanted to do something special.
---
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkc2OmzAUhZ_G7Iz8A9hZeJEpYRSpaauJNF1axr7AlQAjbDKvX6Xt7Gf76d4jfef8vtmbwxnX8YdbwGBKdk92whRX-MA0WcFEQ5mmnFnnMz7AVq4IphZcD7oAw5VupFa15MVkqqp3uq9FzSHASTBW-aH3AZQSoXdaFmieeUxzxnVVS1b6k5KNrgfPQxhg6EnFji24DCWuCQMkH-O2xRkz-lTGfSxmM-W8JSLPRHREdAn8sUPpVggxlz4uRHT97h5Ah7jTMcZARLc5rupaUt6DoBVITx1nA2Wnk_TBg4KmIbI78mJTPHYPRLZvl3cimidaIOCxENlebufr9__Qu2VzOK5Etv-UWGNf2lf70r3-tG-Xd_v32N7O3-ivM73e759_cc2wZiLb6_1OP9sodhO2D5xnTI0iFRsXh_NTpshf3eRhxJ8AAAD__00zkPg)
---
| | First, we were able to send him a birthday surprise box with his own Iggy puppet, which had been sold-out. **[BUT this week, BRAVE FOR GOOD had the incredible privilege of fulfilling Mac's wish.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkc2OmzAUhZ_G7Iz8A9hZeJEpYRSpaauJNF1axr7AlQAjbDKvX6Xt7Gf76d4jfef8vtmbwxnX8YdbwGBKdk92whRX-MA0WcFEQ5mmnFnnMz7AVq4IphZcD7oAw5VupFa15MVkqqp3uq9FzSHASTBW-aH3AZQSoXdaFmieeUxzxnVVS1b6k5KNrgfPQxhg6EnFji24DCWuCQMkH-O2xRkz-lTGfSxmM-W8JSLPRHREdAn8sUPpVggxlz4uRHT97h5Ah7jTMcZARLc5rupaUt6DoBVITx1nA2Wnk_TBg4KmIbI78mJTPHYPRLZvl3cimidaIOCxENlebufr9__Qu2VzOK5Etv-UWGNf2lf70r3-tG-Xd_v32N7O3-ivM73e759_cc2wZiLb6_1OP9sodhO2D5xnTI0iFRsXh_NTpshf3eRhxJ8AAAD__00zkPg)** As we began filming Season 3 of Iggy and Mr. Kirk, Mac and his family joined us on set for a very special visit.
---
| | | Watching Mac smile, laugh, and spend time with Iggy and the cast was something none of us will ever forget.It was a joyful reminder of why BRAVE FOR GOOD exists. Their strength and unwavering faith were evident throughout their visit, and I keep thinking about something Mac's mom shared with us:Their strength is evident in a note Mac's mom wrote:
---
| | | _“We wanted so bad for our life to be normal, and even more so for Mac’s life to be normal. We didn’t know that God’s purpose for us was to be joyful in affliction, joyful in tribulation, and faithful in the role He had put us in. We realized we were gripping too hard on the ease we wanted for Mac and for our family, and not loosening it to open hands in faithfulness to God.”_
---

Mac came into this world not breathing. | | | | Dear Friend,I want to introduce you to a little boy named Mac.Mac is five years old.He lives in Tennessee with his mom and dad and brother and sister.Mac came into this world not breathing. And since then, his life has been an endless series of hospitalizations, pain, and setbacks | | | Mac just had a kidney transplant and is currently battling the complications of that.I want to tell you about Mac because his story perfectly captures why BRAVE FOR GOOD exists. | | | | | It's our mega-hit Mister Rogers-inspired TV show starring our friend Kirk Cameron and an adorable iguana puppet we named "Iggy." Families across America have embraced the show because it brings biblical values straight into their homes through stories children love.But nothing has impacted me quite like Mac's story.We first learned about Mac when we were contacted by the Make-A-Wish Foundation. If you've heard of the Make-A-Wish Foundation, you know they grant requests from children facing critical illnesses. Mac's mom tells us that during their dark times, watching Iggy and Mr. Kirk "was like a nice little happy ending no matter what was going on."She says Mac loves the theme song and that their seven and nine-year-old "really get" the virtues the show is teaching them through storytelling.She catches them "correcting" each other when one of them has been selfish or jealous or a million of the little things we all do every day - because of a biblical lesson they learned from Iggy and Mr. Kirk. Think about that for a minute.In Tennessee, a family going through the darkest days a family could ever go through gathered on the couch surrounding Mac to watch Iggy and Mr. Kirk.This family was strengthened in virtue. And Mac's giggles and contagious smile reminded them that in all the struggles, God's joy, faith, and goodness remain. At a time when so much of today's children's entertainment leaves parents searching for something better, we're creating stories that point children toward courage...Honesty...Kindness...Forgiveness...And, most importantly, faith in God.When we heard about Mac, we wanted to do something special. | | | | | First, we were able to send him a birthday surprise box with his own Iggy puppet, which had been sold-out. As we began filming Season 3 of Iggy and Mr. Kirk, Mac and his family joined us on set for a very special visit. | | | Watching Mac smile, laugh, and spend time with Iggy and the cast was something none of us will ever forget.It was a joyful reminder of why BRAVE FOR GOOD exists. Their strength and unwavering faith were evident throughout their visit, and I keep thinking about something Mac's mom shared with us:Their strength is evident in a note Mac's mom wrote: | | | “We wanted so bad for our life to be normal, and even more so for Mac’s life to be normal. We didn’t know that God’s purpose for us was to be joyful in affliction, joyful in tribulation, and faithful in the role He had put us in. We realized we were gripping too hard on the ease we wanted for Mac and for our family, and not loosening it to open hands in faithfulness to God.” “We wanted so bad for our life to be normal, and even more so for Mac’s life to be normal. We didn’t know that God’s purpose for us was to be joyful in affliction, joyful in tribulation, and faithful in the role He had put us in. We realized we were gripping too hard on the ease we wanted for Mac and for our family, and not loosening it to open hands in faithfulness to God.” | | | | | If those words resonate with you, I'm asking you to become part of BRAVE FOR GOOD's mission.God did not create us for "easy."We were created for so much more. “ For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.” [2 Corinthians 4:17-18] With SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY, our Bible Revival movement, and Season 3 of Iggy and Mr. Kirk all moving forward at the same time, we need faithful friends to help us continue reaching children and families with wholesome, Godly values.Your tax-deductible gift today will help us reach many more children like Mac and encourage families searching for entertainment they can truly trust.We would be truly grateful for your support.Thank you for taking the time to read Mac's story. I hope you'll join us.Sincerely, | | | Dr. Trent Talbot Founder, BRAVE For Good | | | | P.S. **We’ve got one day left** to knock doors, make phone calls, talk to our friends and neighbors, and ensure every progressive has a plan to vote.
It’s been a long campaign, and our communities have been through a lot under Trump’s authoritarian rule. But we are seeing incredible energy across the board as we build the groundswell needed to replace the MAGA majority in Congress with a real team of progressive fighters.
Whether you live in Minnesota’s Fifth or have been supporting from afar, every dollar you donated, every time you boosted our message, even every email you opened helped our campaign continue to bring people together around our working class agenda.

You may be wondering what a contribution can do right now, with so little time left. **We’re here to tell you: everything!**
Every dollar we can raise today goes right back into our GOTV operation, meaning it goes right back into real organizing on the ground here in Minnesota — the kind of organizing that lays the foundation for victory in November.

Peter,

My name is Mike Carey. I represent Ohio's 15th Congressional District. Here's what's still on the primary calendar: Tennessee voted **August 6th**. Virginia and Washington voted this week. Wisconsin, Minnesota, Connecticut, and Vermont vote **August 11th.** Florida and Alaska vote on **August 18th.** Delaware doesn't close until **September 15th!**

Derek, in 2018, the year after Donald Trump took office for the first time, Democrats across the country made an irrefutable statement rejecting his chaos and cruelty by flipping the House blue.
That historic victory was made possible in large part by hundreds of thousands of voters right here in Virginia who came out to flip three Republican-held seats.
This year, we find ourselves with another major opportunity. Like in 2018, millions of Americans are reeling from Trump’s presidency — the havoc he’s wreaked on our economy, the needless and foolish (and illegal) war in Iran, the terror in our communities from his rogue ICE agency.
And like in 2018, we have a chance to flip at least three Republican-held seats in Virginia.
The general election has officially begun, and with just 85 days left until Election Day, our great Democratic nominees in Virginia’s 1st, 2nd, and 5th districts need our support to get ready to win.
Will you split a donation between Shannon Taylor, Elaine Luria, and Tom Perriello today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026-va125]
CONTRIBUTE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026-va125]

I can tell you first-hand from the races I’ve run in Virginia how meaningful your support is. Congressional campaigns operate on slim margins, and a donation of $5 or $10 really does add up to make stronger voter outreach possible.
This is particularly important when we’re up against outside MAGA money ready to flood the Commonwealth. We know the GOP is desperate to hold onto their majority — so candidates like Shannon, Elaine, and Tom are relying on grassroots supporters to step up whenever and however they can to help counter Republican attacks and reach every voter in their districts.
I’m going to be reaching out to this great team regularly between now and Election Day to make sure you’re plugged into the races that need your support, and I really appreciate you reading these emails and chipping in when you can.
If you’re in a position to contribute, I hope you’ll split a donation between Shannon Taylor’s campaign in VA-1, Elaine Luria’s campaign in VA-2, and Tom Perriello’s campaign in VA-5 — these are three must-win seats and could determine the balance of power come November. Last week, I joined U.S. Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Rollins in Douglas to announce a major win for Arizona's ranchers, rural communities, and border economy. For months, Speaker Mike Johnson looked at the Epstein files -- years of documented abuse, real victims, real crimes -- and called it a "shiny object."
A shiny object.
Johnson didn't think this years-long cycle of abuse deserves the full weight of a serious investigation. Just a "shiny object" and a Democratic "cudgel," according to the Speaker of the House.
Let me tell you something. I'm a farmer. When something's rotten, you deal with it, because ignoring rot doesn't make it go away -- it just spreads.
Mike Johnson knew exactly what he was doing. While pressure built to release the files, he kept the House out of session for a full month during the shutdown fight -- conveniently delaying the exact legislative process that would have forced a vote. That's not an accident. That's a Speaker running out the clock for the man he answers to.
When Trump wanted the files buried, Mike Johnson buried them -- for months -- until the political math changed and he had no choice left but to reverse course. That alone should be disqualifying for Congress.

Friends,
**Today at 5 p.m. is the deadline** to submit public comments to the Board of State Canvassers regarding the 100-word summary for the Citizen Only Voting Amendment on the November ballot.
We need your help making sure the Board hears from supporters who want Michigan voters to receive a clear, accurate description of what our amendment actually does. Unfortunately, opponents of Citizen Only Voting continue to misrepresent the proposal, particularly when it comes to citizenship verification and voter registration.
**Let's be very clear: Our proposal DOES NOT require proof of citizenship in order to register to vote.** It also does not prohibit the use of a Michigan driver's license or state ID to register.
Instead, our amendment establishes commonsense safeguards designed to protect every eligible voter and every lawful vote.
The proposal would:• **Require photo identification to vote.**
• **Require the Secretary of State to verify citizenship using available data after registration.**
• **Require a systematic review of Michigan's voter rolls** to help ensure they remain accurate and that voting eligibility is properly verified.
These distinctions matter. Michigan voters deserve a ballot summary that accurately describes the amendment they will be asked to consider in November, not one shaped by political rhetoric or inaccurate claims about what the proposal requires.
**Please take a few minutes today to submit comments to the Board of State Canvassers in support of a 100-word summary that clearly outlines what the proposal does as outlined above. Comments can be sent to **[MDOS-Canvassers@michigan.gov](mailto:MDOS-Canvassers@michigan.gov)**.**
**Comments must be submitted by 5 p.m. TODAY.**
When you write, please respectfully urge the Board to maintain an accurate summary that reflects the actual language and requirements of the Citizen Only Voting Amendment.
We have worked incredibly hard to bring this proposal before Michigan voters. Now we need to make sure voters are given a fair and accurate explanation of what it does.**Please submit your comments before 5 p.m. and encourage other supporters to do the same.**
Every voter deserves clarity. Every lawful vote deserves protection.
Thank you for standing with us.Citizen Only Voting Michigan Team

body:
The GOP-controlled recount commission tossed out several ballots to ensure Trump's endorsed candidate won.

|
---

He must be removed immediately and replaced with someone qualified to lead the Pentagon. **Every day Hegseth remains in charge of the Defense Department, he puts our troops and our national security at greater risk.** [**Add your name, and demand he be removed.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T943cd02e-5789-402c-83d3-46a5d9bc3bd3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **Already took this action?[Go here for more](https://default.salsalabs.org/T25d1eb36-43a0-4597-ac78-03581720e9ee/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9).** [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T00c207a8-51b1-4fd8-ad8c-d42f2bdf0a4d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) This is the man who shared highly sensitive details about an impending military attack in a Signal chat that mistakenly included a journalist. He has systematically pushed out experienced generals and other senior military leaders, weakening the Pentagon and replacing military expertise with personal loyalty and political ideology. He came into the job without anything close to the experience needed to manage one of the largest, most complicated, and most consequential organizations in the world. And instead of approaching that enormous responsibility with competence and judgment, he has repeatedly behaved recklessly, created unnecessary chaos, and treated the Pentagon like his own political playground. That would be dangerous at any time. **But it is completely intolerable during an active war, when American service members are being killed and wounded and every reckless decision can have catastrophic consequences.** Our troops deserve leaders who know what they are doing. Their lives should not depend on the judgment of an unqualified political appointee who has repeatedly demonstrated that he is not up to the job. **[Sign your name, and demand that he be removed NOW.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5cc4db3b-62fb-49d0-99dd-7654ebd4cb7e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

He must be removed immediately and replaced with someone qualified to lead the Pentagon. He alleged that many Americans "inherit a... tradition of ignorance" due to "years of marinating in Fox News." Sayed has also advocated for Sharia Law, criticizing Oklahoma for previously considering a ballot measure that would've banned Islamic Law. Sayed **[likened](https://substack.com/redirect/7622127d-ead5-4fc7-9118-fef7af9daae7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the measure to the Trail of Tears and called it part of Oklahoma's "history of racism."
Sayed has a long history of exaggeration, including when it comes to his own profession. While it is true that he earned an MD from Columbia University's College of Physicians and Surgeons, he never completed a residency or obtained a medical license. His only experience came from a month-long clinical rotation, during which he **[described](https://substack.com/redirect/f0aded66-37e7-4559-b9be-cf3521d630c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** himself as "cosplaying as a doctor." Sayed has referred to himself as a physician and doctor multiple times despite **[Michigan law](https://substack.com/redirect/d1e391be-4a4f-447c-8cc4-9a4f9ee07f82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** outlining that it is illegal to "induce the belief" that a person is "licensed or registered in the profession." Sayed even went so far as to publish a book titled "A Doctor's Journey into the Heart of Our Political Epidemic." The book frames him as a practicing doctor, with **[reviews](https://substack.com/redirect/e138e5b9-0fc6-4703-8a51-42bc354cd34d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** labelling him as a "physician" who could "heal the sick."
Sayed has used his MD as an excuse to push his progressive agenda. He has advocated for "Medicare For All" programs and called for the abolishment of all medical debt. Democratic Representative Ro Khanna doubled down, **[saying](https://substack.com/redirect/6c7603ae-ec9e-43fb-a330-361b0a756ff7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that Sayed would "stick to Medicare for all... That was the central issue that's winning this race for him." During 2020, he called to defund the police, and has previously **[said](https://substack.com/redirect/f59956b9-a03e-4458-80ac-6db16f5c35ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that "Rather than investing in a force of people who respond with guns and put people in jails what if we... [invest] less in police." However, one of the greatest signs of where Sayed's allegiance lies comes from his relationship with DSA Rep. AOC. During a campaign rally she valiantly declared, "We have to elect Abdul!" Which is perhaps the worst endorsement of all.

body:
Small Town PAC is supporting Democrats who refuse to be bullied into silence.
#
Peter,
Donald Trump and his allies are counting on fear to do their work for them.
They want public servants to think twice before speaking up. They want people to wonder whether standing up for their neighbors will make them a target. They want Democratic leaders looking over their shoulders instead of looking out for the people they were elected to serve.
_That is not how this country is supposed to work._
When the Trump DOJ came after me and other Minnesota leaders, it was never really about one politically motivated subpoena or one bogus investigation. It was about sending a message: challenge us, and there will be consequences.
**Well, here’s my message back: We do not get bullied into silence. We do not let the Department of Justice become a political weapon. And we do not abandon our communities just because Donald Trump wants people afraid.**
Small Town PAC is working to support Democrats who understand that standing up to the politics of fear is part of the job — leaders who show up, tell the truth, and fight for people who deserve better than chaos, intimidation, and revenge politics.
[**We need these leaders more than ever. And electing them takes resources. Friend,

This month, millions of American students are returning to campus. And what's waiting for them isn't just a syllabus. _It 's a socialist ambush_.
* An online influencer convincing them that capitalism is theft.
* A professor telling them that achievement is a privilege.
* A roommate chastising them because ambition, hard work and success is "selfish."

**By the time most students unpack their dorm room, at least three separate voices have already told them that success is something to apologize for.**

We know it's working because we've watched it happen in real time.

Last November, a Democratic Socialist won the mayoral race in New York City, which was once the beating heart of American capitalism. And he was only the beginning... Democratic Socialists of America-backed candidates have won nearly half of their races so far in the 2026 primary elections.

That result is what happens when young people are fed socialist propaganda for years on end. And it's a story being written one campus at a time.

I'm Jennifer Anju Grossman, CEO of The Atlas Society. We're the organization built to answer those three voices, reaching students through animated videos, graphic novels, podcasts, and student conferences that make the moral case for achievement, ambition, and individual freedom, drawing on the philosophy of Ayn Rand.

Which is exactly why I'm writing to you today, Friend, before this semester gets fully underway.

[Help me put Ayn Rand’s ideas in front of students this semester, in a way that is more convincing than the professor, the influencer, and the roommate combined.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=783a1a0a47d046b2835dd7afca84388c&_e=naCXk6RGUBYQTTmgQUVGsZtVLzJ_QzvjOVmsUU9Wqh8sTILzPYApI7Xdpkl2BZ_gPiW4y1NJtWJp3JCtsCGztjMXHlrO1nKhKwGb79i0jhhp2tBnmpd6RHNV3Ej8EnphzQBPuFbsGhy3mKJffST7irWQhovC_gGc_3kMxNF-peEeVth5W19SOHdUcZEMjZSLMjEhhXAYJ_JsNq8JsWw7uBvo1kGOgyfOqWset0WgmEtOW-twSZ2eQAYg2HgAUMKiXPYmk_EimmpCzitlE3d7u9kKnpZUX_rgs9UTGdpqtVdxvkCDUvHYktMlR4Ci8g6fNlR3Pz-6lNWjumTiBHDOKeANa28t1b2ZW1tOWKBtCVLqDI0kiB47Y9wRMfYt9QutXv-B4meUSKh8b5ADmmc2YMZRdTaTmCrgIEGNN9yrCJ1hot8Ur3FWp03dgLZIUwaWGcy8np4LOBJxF0i6gbQKpr1YVzLS6J9hV3d1hRauwTc52fwrC3XUMoY_zLo2APIGkCIfwyVLLtFOB8jVyOHlS7O3rcem5KsyEg_7yhVfQW5nrCQw0FAEouTN8FpYGubRBY3ga-xnZJXaQr1695HO9qtcNHOLSCTpt59z_UhL236YTFTke1hZ3BYBKoYUL7AW)

The ideological fight against socialism wasn't abstract or theoretical to Ayn Rand. She watched collectivism crush lives under Soviet rule (breadlines, censorship, confiscation of property, the erosion of the individual).

**Now, those same terrible collectivist ideas are being repackaged for TikTok and taught in lecture halls as "compassion".**

Ayn Rand called art "the indispensable medium for the communication of moral ideals." The socialists have clearly taken note. That's how they came to own the feed.

**But here 's what the other side doesn't understand about people like you, Friend. **

A donor who funds a Draw My Life video that a student shares with her roommate has just out-influenced the influencer, without ever posting a single thing herself. A donor who underwrites a John Galt School session in Nairobi or Lima has reached further into a young mind than any algorithm, because that student walked away having wrestled with a philosophical concept in depth, not scrolled past it in four seconds.

**That 's the kind of influence a well-placed donation actually buys: not a follower count, but a changed mind that goes on to change others.**

We're building the machine that turns your gift into exactly that kind of reach.

Every donor to The Atlas Society has the power to be more influential than the loudest voice in the room, without saying a word publicly.

**It only takes $10 to reach 2,000 young minds with the philosophy of reason, achievement, individualism, and freedom.**

clean_body: Friend, This month, millions of American students are returning to campus. And what's waiting for them isn't just a syllabus. It 's a socialist ambush. An online influencer convincing them that capitalism is theft. A professor telling them that achievement is a privilege. A roommate chastising them because ambition, hard work and success is "selfish." By the time most students unpack their dorm room, at least three separate voices have already told them that success is something to apologize for. We know it's working because we've watched it happen in real time. Last November, a Democratic Socialist won the mayoral race in New York City, which was once the beating heart of American capitalism. And he was only the beginning... Democratic Socialists of America-backed candidates have won nearly half of their races so far in the 2026 primary elections. That result is what happens when young people are fed socialist propaganda for years on end. And it's a story being written one campus at a time. I'm Jennifer Anju Grossman, CEO of The Atlas Society. We're the organization built to answer those three voices, reaching students through animated videos, graphic novels, podcasts, and student conferences that make the moral case for achievement, ambition, and individual freedom, drawing on the philosophy of Ayn Rand. Which is exactly why I'm writing to you today, Friend, before this semester gets fully underway. Every $10 you give reaches 2,000 young minds with her profound message of reason, achievement, benevolence, and rational self-interest. The ideological fight against socialism wasn't abstract or theoretical to Ayn Rand. She watched collectivism crush lives under Soviet rule (breadlines, censorship, confiscation of property, the erosion of the individual). Now, those same terrible collectivist ideas are being repackaged for TikTok and taught in lecture halls as "compassion". Ayn Rand called art "the indispensable medium for the communication of moral ideals." The socialists have clearly taken note. That's how they came to own the feed. But here 's what the other side doesn't understand about people like you, Friend. A donor who funds a Draw My Life video that a student shares with her roommate has just out-influenced the influencer, without ever posting a single thing herself. A donor who underwrites a John Galt School session in Nairobi or Lima has reached further into a young mind than any algorithm, because that student walked away having wrestled with a philosophical concept in depth, not scrolled past it in four seconds. That 's the kind of influence a well-placed donation actually buys: not a follower count, but a changed mind that goes on to change others. We're building the machine that turns your gift into exactly that kind of reach. Every donor to The Atlas Society has the power to be more influential than the loudest voice in the room, without saying a word publicly. It only takes $10 to reach 2,000 young minds with the philosophy of reason, achievement, individualism, and freedom.** With grit, grace, and gratitude, Jennifer Anju Grossman (JAG) CEO, The Atlas Society The Atlas Society is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. All donations are tax-deductible.

subject: Judicial Watch: FBI Says It Will Take 158 Years to Process ‘Hidden Room’ Records
body:
Judicial Watch announced that the FBI has told a federal court that, at a rate of 500 pages a month, processing records from the “hidden room” at FBI Headquarters would take approximately 158 years. The room — now dubbed the “burn bag room” — holds over 2 million pages of records, according to the FBI’s own filing.

# Tomorrow’s the Day

Peter,This is it! Tomorrow is election day, and I have been sitting here trying to wrap my head around how fast it all went.Eighteen months ago I was one guy on a street corner in New Richmond, freezing my tail off with a homemade sign, not at all sure anybody agreed with me.Since then we have driven this enormous district end to end more times than I can count. We have stood together at rallies and county fairs and pancake breakfasts, in town halls and church basements and powwow grounds, on radio shows and a debate stage. We had thousands of honest conversations with folks who were scared and angry and ready for something better.You did all of that. Every mile, dollar, door, and every neighbor you talked into caring.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

**I am not exaggerating when I say I would not be here without you, because I mean it literally. This movement has been ours from the very first day.** So no matter what those numbers say tomorrow night, I want you to know how deeply grateful I am. Getting to meet the people of this district and fight alongside them has been one of the great honors of my life.Now come celebrate with us. Diana and I are throwing open the Packer garage tomorrow, Tuesday, August 11, from 6 to 10 pm at our place in New Richmond. Email [hello@armstrongforwisconsin.com](mailto:hello@armstrongforwisconsin.com) if you need the details.Bring yourself, bring a friend, and let's watch the results roll in together the way we did everything else, side by side. Thank you. From the bottom of my heart. See you tomorrow night.Thanks, Chris ~:|

name: Team Gina
subject: born and raised in the Rio Grande Valley
body:
Gina’s been winning tough fights for her entire life.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
This is Gina. She grew up in the Rio Grande Valley, attending Brownsville public schools.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260810_2_bio.wxyTdw&refcode=em20260810-1797&t=1&akid=1797%2E299639%2EIF1R7A)
_Picture day at Egly Elementary in Brownsville, TX_
At an early age, Gina’s grandmother taught her an important lesson: _No te dejes._ _Fight back_. It’s a lesson that Gina has carried with her for her entire life — and it’s what she’s doing today as she runs to be the next Governor of Texas.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260810_2_bio.wxyTdw&refcode=em20260810-1797&t=2&akid=1797%2E299639%2EIF1R7A)
_Born and raised in the Valley_
Gina never planned to run for office. But when her son’s elementary school was threatened for closure by state budget cuts, she rallied other parents, ran for Austin ISD School Board, and won. She kept her son’s school open, along with every other public school in the district.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260810_2_bio.wxyTdw&refcode=em20260810-1797&t=3&akid=1797%2E299639%2EIF1R7A)
_The Austin Chronicle endorsed her race for school board_
But neighborhood schools kept closing across the state because Republican leaders kept diverting Texas tax dollars away from schools. So Gina ran for a seat in the Texas House of Representatives — and she won. In 2019, she helped win an investment of more than $11 billion in Texas public schools.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260810_2_bio.wxyTdw&refcode=em20260810-1797&t=4&akid=1797%2E299639%2EIF1R7A)
_On the floor of the Texas State House_
**Now, Gina is the official Democratic nominee running to unseat Greg Abbott.** She’s been winning tough fights for her entire life, and she has what it takes to do it again this November.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260810_2_bio.wxyTdw&refcode=em20260810-1797&t=5&akid=1797%2E299639%2EIF1R7A)
_Years later, she’s still fighting back. No te dejes._
A new poll shows Gina tied with Abbott — _in a district he last won by 10 points._ That means we have the momentum behind us, but with only six months until Election Day, Gina’s relying on your urgent support to scale up her campaign before it’s too late.
**[If you’re in this fight with Gina, will you please donate $5 right now to power her fight to November? Any amount you can contribute will go a long way in building a campaign strong enough to flip Texas.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260810_2_bio.wxyTdw&refcode=em20260810-1797&amount=5&t=6&akid=1797%2E299639%2EIF1R7A)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260810_2_bio.wxyTdw&amount=5&refcode=em20260810-1797&t=25&akid=1797%2E299639%2EIF1R7A)
Thank you,
– Gina Hinojosa HQ

name: Raja Krishnamoorthi
subject: IT’S TIME FOR THE POSTMASTER GENERAL TO RESIGN!
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
When it comes to Donald Trump and the MAGA Extremists, one thing is absolutely certain: The grift never, EVER stops.
Right now, the head of the United States Postal Service is doing Donald Trump's dirty work — implementing an executive order that federal courts have already ruled unconstitutional. Twice.
Here's what's happening:
Trump signed an executive order aimed at controlling how election mail is handled in this country — an order two separate federal courts have already blocked as unconstitutional. Most people would call that settled. Postmaster General David Steiner didn't.
Now, Postmaster General Steiner refuses to tell Congress whether his agency is complying with a federal court order. Even after the injunction. Even after the First Circuit ruled against Trump again on July 25th.
Let's call this exactly what it is: The United States Postal Service — an institution that is supposed to serve every American equally, no matter their zip code or their politics — has been turned into a partisan instrument of voter suppression.
This is deliberate. Trump wants control over how your ballot gets delivered, and he found someone running USPS who's willing to give it to him — court orders be damned.
I sent Steiner a letter demanding answers. I want to know every step USPS has taken to implement this order, every piece of guidance sent to postal workers, and exactly why he thinks he's above two federal court rulings. I gave him until August 13th to respond. I'm also calling on the USPS Board of Governors to remove him.
Because here's the thing: Republicans in Congress won't hold this administration accountable for anything — not the corruption, not the lawlessness, not the open attacks on our elections. So we will. At the polls, on the ballot, and across this country in this year's midterms.

It's hard to trust that your representative is working for you when he's doubled his net worth since taking office and he has a higher-performing stock portfolio than Warren Buffett or Bill Gates.

subject: I’m focused on what’s next

body:
Grappling with these issues was a big reason why I decided to run for reelection

|
---

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136989566/639268098/1079622208?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_AI_260810_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNWU4MTQwZi1mZDk0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0mw_opRzJSMY-ZEQc7-9UqCrG0bVC8YCs7TWZns14B0=) Derek, for my entire career, I’ve been focused on what’s next and what’s on the horizon.

I invested in cell phones back when everyone was using a landline. So I know there's no turning back the clock on AI – and I'm actually an optimist about what it can do.

But short-term? I'm hair-on-fire worried about it. Frankly, grappling with the changes AI will bring to our economy and our communities is a big reason I decided to run for reelection.

**So here's what I'm doing about it – and what comes next:**
* **Data centers.** I introduced a framework to rein in data centers – setting federal standards for energy and water use, keeping them a fair distance from homes, and making sure Virginians get the facts they need to make decisions about their communities.

* **Your family's safety online.** We royally screwed up on social media. I'm not letting that happen again with AI chatbots. I introduced a framework to get these systems tested by real experts before they reach your kids and give survivors a meaningful path to justice when those protections fail.

* **Our national security.** If the United States wants to lead the world in artificial intelligence, we can’t simply build the best models – we need to build the most trusted ones. So I'm working on legislation to make sure the most powerful AI models get tested for security risks before they're deployed.

* **Your job.** AI is going to disrupt our economy like nothing we've seen. I'm leading the push to track how it's hitting workers community by community – so policymakers have the realtime data we need. And I introduced bipartisan legislation to build a reskilling pathway so people aren't left behind, and folks are getting the training they need for the jobs that are actually out there.

**Derek, the big tech companies aren't going to fix this on their own. We need to elect leaders who are going to tackle these issues head-on, protect working families, and make sure our country comes out of these changes in a strong position.**

Americans have never been not scared of the future, and we can’t start now. So I'm not going to sit back and let a handful of giant tech companies decide who wins and who gets left behind, either – not on your energy bill, not on your kids, not on your security, not on your job.

That’s why I’m running for reelection – and it’s why I’m asking you to support this campaign and make sure we have the resources we need to win this November.

I introduced a framework to rein in data centers – setting federal standards for energy and water use, keeping them a fair distance from homes, and making sure Virginians get the facts they need to make decisions about their communities. Your family's safety online. We royally screwed up on social media. I'm not letting that happen again with AI chatbots. I introduced a framework to get these systems tested by real experts before they reach your kids and give survivors a meaningful path to justice when those protections fail. Our national security. If the United States wants to lead the world in artificial intelligence, we can’t simply build the best models – we need to build the most trusted ones. A former union organizer , Angie has taken on corporate price-gouging , led the fight against Florida Governor DeSantis’s unfair voting maps , and expanded childcare for thousands of families. This working-class champion is running against an anti-Muslim genocide denier and millionaire, who’s running on name recognition alone. Unlike Angie, who’s lived her whole life in Florida, her centrist opponent just moved to the state a few years ago. Like we’ve seen with Abdul El-Sayed’s race to represent Michigan in the Senate, Angie performs better than her Democratic opponent in polls against the Republican on November’s ballot. Friends,
Two hundred fifty years in, and America is still the greatest experiment in liberty the world has ever known. As the son of immigrants who came to this country seeking freedom and opportunity, I've never taken that for granted. My parents chose America because they believed in its promise—a nation where freedom is protected, hard work is rewarded, and anyone can build a better future.
That same promise continues to inspire me today. There truly is no other country on earth that has done more to expand freedom, create opportunity, and empower ordinary people to achieve extraordinary things. Our nation's story is one of resilience, sacrifice, and an unwavering belief that tomorrow can be better than today.
As we continue to celebrate our nation's 250th year, I'm grateful for the privilege of calling America home and more committed than ever to preserving the freedoms and values that make our country exceptional.
That is why I am excited to announce our one-of-a-kind event series, "What Is America to Me?" We will host five events, each centered on a different theme that has shaped our nation, from the American Dream and our Founding Fathers to faith, freedom, and the challenges facing America's future. I hope you'll join me as we celebrate our country, reflect on what makes America exceptional, and discuss how we can preserve those values for the next generation.
Check out our event schedule on our website, [Z4AZ.com/calendar](https://us.list-manage.com/6CYWzwBfq1u?e=6477bcd9cd&c2id=f05c70fe8231dcabc26816038b27d5aa).

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | Friends, Two hundred fifty years in, and America is still the greatest experiment in liberty the world has ever known. As the son of immigrants who came to this country seeking freedom and opportunity, I've never taken that for granted. My parents chose America because they believed in its promise—a nation where freedom is protected, hard work is rewarded, and anyone can build a better future. That same promise continues to inspire me today. There truly is no other country on earth that has done more to expand freedom, create opportunity, and empower ordinary people to achieve extraordinary things. Our nation's story is one of resilience, sacrifice, and an unwavering belief that tomorrow can be better than today. As we continue to celebrate our nation's 250th year, I'm grateful for the privilege of calling America home and more committed than ever to preserving the freedoms and values that make our country exceptional. That is why I am excited to announce our one-of-a-kind event series, "What Is America to Me?" We will host five events, each centered on a different theme that has shaped our nation, from the American Dream and our Founding Fathers to faith, freedom, and the challenges facing America's future. I hope you'll join me as we celebrate our country, reflect on what makes America exceptional, and discuss how we can preserve those values for the next generation. subject: A deep sense of gratitude
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Don Ufford For Michigan
body:
| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/c9zfQjyK8s5lr1g7VH2Qvw~~/AAUS1hA~/zaN3h-GMgFYCwpLb3MyKbgQVpWU0Kc7DbcEv0lyyJNiFTnadQm7j06kd1X78wcNiAexWFgXMuN4IQXIxtpgEpFOaZub8WH3DPtMD6LNZWxWVUA7cTG_leYFe_Zq69eI5)
| | Friends, I’m writing with a deep sense of gratitude. While we didn’t get the result we hoped for on Election Day, I could not be more proud of the campaign we built together—and I want you to know how grateful I am that you were part of it. We started with a simple belief: people are hungry for something different in our politics. They want leaders who will listen, put people ahead of special interests, and fight to make sure everyone has a fair shot. Together, we turned that belief into an extraordinary grassroots campaign. We knocked on more than 30,000 doors and raised more than $1 million around our message of Fighting for Fairness—to push back against the Trump Administration’s attacks on working people, create good-paying jobs, lower costs for families, and protect access to healthcare. And we did it without taking a single dollar of corporate PAC money. I am deeply grateful to the thousands of volunteers and supporters who gave their time, opened their homes, knocked doors, made calls, hosted events, put up signs, and donated what they could. And I am enormously grateful to our campaign staff, Mark, Anna, and Izzy, who believed in this effort and built an organization from the ground up including an amazing team of fellows. Together, we worked extraordinarily hard, gave this campaign everything we had, and never stopped believing in what we could accomplish. I’m also grateful to my family—and especially Rebecca, who was always ready to make calls, send texts (she got locked out of her phone by Apple for sending so many), knock doors, meet voters and stand-in for me to speak with groups when I was double booked. I could not have done this without her. I haven’t been shy about saying we need to get big money out of politics, and losing this race hasn’t changed my mind. People are crying out for change. We owe it to them to listen. Our campaign manager, Mark Goldenberg, ended every fundraiser with words from Margaret Mead that feel especially meaningful to me now: _“Never doubt that a small group of thoughtful, committed citizens can change the world. Indeed, it is the only thing that ever has.”_ We didn’t win this election, but what we built mattered. Bringing together thousands of people around the idea that our politics can—and should—be more fair, matters. Thank you for believing in this campaign, in our message, and in me. I will always be grateful. With deep appreciation, Don Ufford

Hey folks,
Dr. Oz went to Wisconsin with a simple message: Trump has your back on healthcare.
There's just one problem. What the Trump administration is actually doing tells a very different story.
In this episode, I break down what Oz is telling Americans about rural healthcare, what's happening behind the scenes with Medicaid, and why these cuts could leave ordinary people paying more while getting less. This is exactly the kind of political bait-and-switch we need to understand--and fight.
* [**00:00:29**] Dr. Oz heads to Wisconsin and promises the "Badger State" will be taken care of as concerns grow about rural hospitals and healthcare access.
* [**00:01:13**] I break down why Oz's promises don't match what the Trump administration is actually proposing for Medicaid.
* [**00:02:31**] Here's the part everyone needs to understand: Washington can call these "savings," but the costs don't simply disappear. States--and ultimately taxpayers--can be left carrying the burden.
* [**00:04:18**] We get to the heart of it: Americans could wind up paying more while getting less access to the basic services families depend on.
* [**00:06:22**] The stakes become very real in Wisconsin as I walk through the potential impact on healthcare coverage, rural communities, state finances, and the political backlash Republicans could face.

This isn't some abstract fight over numbers in Washington. It's about whether your hospital stays open. Whether your family can afford care. Whether getting sick means financial ruin. And whether politicians can promise to protect programs like Medicaid while pursuing policies that could undermine the people who depend on them.
We have to keep exposing the gap between what politicians say and what their policies actually do. And we have to make sure people understand what's at stake before they walk into the voting booth.

Jeff Landy, Louisiana’s ultra-MAGA governor has signalled a desire to go even further on his extreme law and order policies: “we’ve got 18,000 acres at Angola prison, if it were up to me I’d send them
| | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LUjf-_oMZY6PR5IKO3w5viH2Alyp3mdffTj8t6I0vgNwkXRCtZDqDzAyjRuPpSFrEGM2By3SL9uSHWrKb94ZdI4W2igwSsKdvNIkBdZ-txNBKgJZ3TxxVkHMhKVq3hcnPdILJsDvs6e5AFnUr6_ctvvZ-bRdEeb4eAp9ro9cbmweEYx4W3mhVUwiq1Ck0b5cDKSI5Du5CAyHLYlJFJIMvcYwORxebe6IXrIBkFm5toQ=&c=SsulTlqtrp60lK6KfP9ZYDhhmtiEhw-c0V_EtU9m9dcJvI-dmVDjkQ==&ch=cYpw2Sjof5HEVBPiBPoK5qyft_6BXh4xMQLoe6VTFq1MJSUCb_iehQ==)

| The state of Louisiana is in the midst of an unprecedented crackdown:
Homeless people convicted of spending a night outside can now face up to a year in jail or a year working to pay off the costs of treatment with a state work crew living in work camps.
National Guard soldiers patrol the streets of New Orleans and ICE is conducting a brutal crackdown across our state that has already killed two detainees this month. Many of the migrants that ICE rounds up head to Louisiana's notorious Angola Prison which is now home to a migrant detention facility.
And now they want to send even more Louisianans to the notorious former plantation turned prison: Angola.
Jeff Landy, Louisiana's ultra-MAGA governor, passed legislation two years ago to ensure people convicted of crimes serve longer prison sentences. Recently, he signalled a desire to go even further saying: "we've got 18,000 acres at Angola, if it were up to me I'd send them all there for the rest of their lives."
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LUjf-_oMZY6PR5IKO3w5viH2Alyp3mdffTj8t6I0vgNwkXRCtZDqDzAyjRuPpSFrEGM2By3SL9uSHWrKb94ZdI4W2igwSsKdvNIkBdZ-txNBKgJZ3TxxVkHMhKVq3hcnPdILJsDvs6e5AFnUr6_ctvvZ-bRdEeb4eAp9ro9cbmweEYx4W3mhVUwiq1Ck0b5cDKSI5Du5CAyHLYlJFJIMvQ8By2FnUT-LYKFamrhSQ9o=&c=SsulTlqtrp60lK6KfP9ZYDhhmtiEhw-c0V_EtU9m9dcJvI-dmVDjkQ==&ch=cYpw2Sjof5HEVBPiBPoK5qyft_6BXh4xMQLoe6VTFq1MJSUCb_iehQ==)

The model of totalitarian control that MAGA hopes to export across the country is being beta tested here in our backyard.
Louisiana is the world's 'prison capital' with the highest overall incarceration rate in the US, averaging 596 incarcerations per 100,000 residents.
Americans jailed for their political opinions with no habeas corpus. Migrants facing torture, disappearance, and death at ICE blacksites to deter others from crossing over. Doctors and abortion recipients serving time for murder. If we can't stop them in Louisiana, it won't stop here, God help us all.
My name is Jamie Davis, a 3rd generation farmer working the same land my great grandfather worked as a sharecropper. My family has put too much blood into this soil for us to pack up and move somewhere else.
I refuse to let them turn my beloved Louisiana into a prison state. I have to take a stand and fight for the way of life that we had when I grew up here as a boy.
It's why I am proud to be the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana. When I am elected I will be the first Black US Senator to be elected in Louisiana. James Carville was so inspired by our performance in our May Primary that he just said our campaign has a "fighting chance" to flip Louisiana's US Senate blue.

And now they want to send even more Louisianans to the notorious former plantation turned prison: Angola. Jeff Landy, Louisiana's ultra-MAGA governor, passed legislation two years ago to ensure people convicted of crimes serve longer prison sentences. body:
Patrick Roath is taking on an entrenched incumbent — and he needs our help before September 1.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260810-1&t=1&akid=3852%2E587540%2EtfCT2L)
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260810_1_roath.SzJJJf&refcode=em20260810-3852&amount=5&t=2&akid=3852%2E587540%2EtfCT2L)
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260810_1_roath.SzJJJf&refcode=em20260810-3852&amount=5&t=3&akid=3852%2E587540%2EtfCT2L)
Peter,
For years, the Democratic Party has asked working people for their votes while refusing to truly fight for them when it matters most.
That’s exactly why Leaders We Deserve is proud to support **Patrick Roath** for Congress.
Patrick isn’t running to serve the establishment. He’s running because Massachusetts deserves a representative who fights unapologetically for working families, affordable health care, immigrant communities, and a progressive Democratic Party that isn’t afraid to stand up for what’s right.
His opponent, **Stephen Lynch,** represents exactly what’s wrong with the establishment.
Lynch was the last Democrat in Congress to vote against the Affordable Care Act, opposing one of the most significant expansions of health care in a generation. More recently, he voted for the Laken Riley Act, helping lay the groundwork for Donald Trump's mass deportation agenda and empowering ICE to expand its campaign of fear in immigrant communities.
**You** deserve better than that.
**You** deserve leaders who will defend health care — not vote against it.
**You** deserve leaders who will protect immigrant families — not hand more power to the politicians weaponizing our immigration system.
Leaders We Deserve exist because we believe a new generation of progressive leaders is ready to lead. Leaders who aren't afraid to challenge entrenched incumbents. Leaders who know that people-powered campaigns — not mega donors or corporate PACs — are how we build a Democratic Party that actually delivers for working people.
But taking on an incumbent Member of Congress isn't easy.
Patrick's primary is on **September 1,** and every conversation with voters between now and then could make the difference.
Every primary we win sends a message that voters are ready for something better.
Let's win another one.
**[Will you split a contribution of $5 today between Patrick Roath and Leaders We Deserve to help elect another fearless progressive who will fight for the future — not the past?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260810_1_roath.SzJJJf&refcode=em20260810-3852&amount=5&t=4&akid=3852%2E587540%2EtfCT2L)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

| Peter, here are 3 things you need to know about what’s happening in Florida that have us fired up: **🔥 ONE: Democrats are showing up.** With early voting underway ahead of Florida’s primary, Democrats currently hold the lead in returned mail ballots. It’s an encouraging sign that voters are energized and ready to make their voices heard, even in a state Republicans take for granted. **🔥 TWO: The economy is costing the GOP support among Hispanic voters.** A statewide poll found that a majority of Florida Hispanic voters now disapprove of Trump’s job performance, driven largely by the cost of living. That’s what happens when politicians spend their time on political stunts instead of the kitchen table issues Floridians actually care about. Come this November, James Uthmeier is going to find that out the hard way. **🔥 THREE: Our campaign has real momentum.** The polls are trending our way, and the energy we’re feeling on the ground is undeniable. **GOP plans to fend off latest Democrat promise for new long-term care benefit** By Gabrielle M. Etzel
---
Republican health policy advisers are starting to push back against Democrats’ plans to create a new long-term care benefit in Medicare health insurance coverage for seniors.

Long-term care, especially home- and community-based programs, for seniors and people with disabilities, is going to be the subject of ideological battle as candidates on both sides of the aisle start to think about their healthcare messaging for the 2028 presidential election season.

Senate Democrats, led by Sen. Ron Wyden (D-OR), began laying the groundwork in May to incorporate home healthcare coverage as part of an agenda to prepare for the party winning both chambers of Congress and the White House in 2028. In particular, Democrats are hoping to include in a new healthcare bill “a home care guarantee for people with Medicare,” the federal health insurance program for seniors over 65.

Bobby Jindal, former GOP governor of Louisiana and health policy expert, told the Washington Examiner that lawmakers should focus on developing workable strategies to address an aging population instead of creating a new entitlement program for long-term elder care.

“Of course the Democrat response is going to simply be let’s just add new benefits and not worry about how to pay for them,” Jindal said. “I think a more thoughtful approach would be to re-examine what should be a Medicaid responsibility, what should be a Medicare responsibility, what should be your private sector responsibility, and what is possible with new technologies.”

Jindal, who now serves as chair of the Healthy America program at the Trump-aligned America First Policy Institute, said it is too early to definitively say what the Republican platform on the problem will look like in the 2028 election, but he says he sees it as a critical issue in the coming years...

Guided by my faith and surrounded by my wife, a high school sweetheart, and our beautiful children, I've experienced firsthand the blessings of America's greatest values.
[My life's mission has been to preserve this American greatness, first by serving in the Air Force and now as a constitutional lawyer fighting anyone who infringes upon our freedom.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow._hC-b1lstO1g)
Yet, I've seen time and time again how fragile our liberty is and the countless evil minds that seek to either take advantage of America or outright destroy it.
And let me tell you, the Radical Leftists have been especially relentless.
They would do anything for their woke agenda, but they would do absolutely nothing for our nation.
[As a proud seventh-generation Texan, I am beyond fed up.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow._0Mlr_FcmPv6L-w)
I'm fighting because Texas needs a leader who is unapologetically patriotic and is not afraid to say so. There are far too many politicians who are bought or compromised, having long forgotten why they decided to serve in the first place.

| | | | |
